sparrow.augment|Inner Fury: Inner Fire fires a wider spread, reaches farther and lasts longer, so more arrows land on grouped enemies. Best in teamfights where she can channel it from safety.
sparrow.Eternal|Thraex: Basic attacks mark her target: she deals more damage to them and takes less from them. Fits her steady single-target attacking while Relentless stacks build.
sparrow.minor|Savage Strikes: Adds a bit of damage to each basic attack that grows while she keeps hitting a hero, and heals her. Strong with Heightened Senses' attack speed.
sparrow.minor|Rallying Roar: Inner Fire comes back a bit sooner, and casting it speeds up Sparrow and nearby allies. Helps the team reposition or chase while she fires.
sparrow.crest|Eviscerator: Activate for faster attacks, healing off damage and bonus damage on basic attacks. Pop it with Heightened Senses to stack Relentless very quickly.
sparrow.augment|Endless Hunt: Each takedown resets Piercing Shot, Hail of Arrows and Heightened Senses and adds permanent armor penetration. After the first kill she can stealth again and keep fighting.
sparrow.minor|Ferocity: Attack speed keeps rising each second Sparrow stays in a hero fight, so long fights favor Sparrow more as they go. Weak in quick skirmishes.
sparrow.crest|Pacifier: Dash and empower her next hit, which hits much harder on low-health targets and can be recast after a kill. Use it to finish someone softened by Piercing Shot.
sparrow.augment|Sun Shards: Basic attacks bounce to extra enemies, dealing reduced damage and applying on-hit item effects at 35% strength. Good for clearing waves and hitting grouped enemies.
sparrow.Eternal|Weald: Hitting a hero below 30% health fires missiles that pass through walls, with more missiles from bonus attack speed, which she builds a lot of. Helps finish low enemies running away.
sparrow.minor|Forage: Extra gold and experience from every minion and monster kill. Generic farming boost, nothing special with her kit.
sparrow.minor|Wind-Rider: Leaving stealth after Heightened Senses gives extra attack speed on top of what the ability already grants, so that damage window hits even faster.
sparrow.minor|Dryad's Boon: No game text is available for Dryad's Boon yet, so its exact effect can't be confirmed. Judge it by its pick rate and win rate rather than a described interaction.
sparrow.Eternal|Vermis: Every third basic attack in a row on the same hero adds damage based on their max health. Rewards staying on one target; great against tanks.
sparrow.minor|Serration: Vermis also adds damage based on the target's missing health, so her third-hit bonus gets stronger as the enemy gets lower.
sparrow.minor|Breach: Inner Fire damage cuts enemy physical armor for a few seconds, so her basic attacks and Piercing Shot hit harder right after her ultimate.
sparrow.Eternal|Marrow: Heals Sparrow for part of damage dealt to heroes, more the lower Sparrow's health is. Area hits heal less, so it favors steady single-target damage.
sparrow.minor|Leech: Nearby enemy heroes regenerate much less health over time. Helps win lane trades where the enemy would otherwise heal back up.
sparrow.crest|Liberator: Removes stuns, slows and other debuffs and gives a short shield. Save it for when she gets caught, then keep attacking or stealth away.
sparrow.minor|Taproot: Basic attacks heal a small amount, more with bonus physical power. Simple steady sustain for lane trades.
sparrow.Eternal|Satariel: Each takedown makes her hit harder and attack faster but lowers her max health, and stacks vanish on death. A high-risk snowball for a Sparrow who stays safe at range.
sparrow.minor|Risen: At 3 or more Fearless stacks she heals off all damage dealt, offsetting the health Satariel takes away once she is snowballing.
sparrow.minor|Broken Wings: Her movement speed can no longer be changed, so slows cannot stick, but she also loses the speed from Heightened Senses and items. Pick it into teams with heavy slows.
sparrow.Eternal|Xyris: Bonus damage that grows as Sparrow kills minions and monsters. Generic farming scaling, not tied to any ability.
sparrow.minor|Iron Will: Basic attacks heal for a small share of their damage, double on critical hits. Better once she builds critical chance.
sparrow.minor|Bone Collector: After killing 150 units she permanently gains 20% critical chance. That boosts her basic attacks and Inner Fire, whose arrows can already critically strike. A farming reward for her late game.
sparrow.minor|Natural Resistance: When she drops low, she breaks free of crowd control and is hard to lock down for a moment. Use that window to stealth with Heightened Senses and escape.
sparrow.Eternal|Krix: Plain bonus maximum health that grows each level. Generic tankiness, nothing special with Sparrow's abilities.
sparrow.minor|Regenerative Tissue: After a while without taking hero damage, Sparrow slowly regenerates health. Helps recover between lane trades without going back to base.
sparrow.minor|Cannibalism: Each takedown permanently adds a little maximum health. Generic tankiness that grows if Sparrow gets kills and assists.
sparrow.crest|Sharpshooter Crest: Each Sparrow basic attack that lands on a hero or monster restores 1 health, and each unit kill restores 3. Heightened Senses' attack speed speeds up the count; after 150 health restored, a base trip upgrades the crest to Legendary.

phase.augment|Kindred Surge: Hyperflux also gives extra speed and health regen to you and your linked ally. Cast it when you engage or need to escape together.
phase.Eternal|Exarch: Healing or shielding speeds up attacks and adds magic damage. Your passive heals you and your linked ally after every ability, so both of you keep the buff up.
phase.minor|Preservation: Heals and shields you receive are stronger. Your passive heals you after every cast, so this boosts your own sustain.
phase.minor|Fervour: Basic attacks on enemy heroes heal you and nearby allies. Pairs with Hyperflux attack speed: auto between abilities to heal your team.
phase.crest|Tranquility: Heals you and nearby allies and briefly reduces damage taken. Use it in a teamfight when the enemy burst lands; it also adds a ward.
phase.augment|Psychic Support: Your passive also restores mana to your linked ally. Great for keeping a mana-hungry carry or mage casting through long fights.
phase.minor|Revelation: Each ability cast shaves a bit off your other cooldowns. Phase rotates abilities often, so you heal and flare more often.
phase.augment|Final Flash: Energy Lance channels for a shorter time but deals more damage, so you spend less time standing still and get a faster burst.
phase.Eternal|Demiurge: Mostly a generic stat boost: every item you buy gives a bit more, and item effects hit harder. Nothing specific to Phase's kit.
phase.minor|Bio-Mechanical Fusion: Turns magical power into physical power, so your basic attacks hit harder. Only does anything if you build magical power.
phase.minor|Memory Leak: Each ability cast slowly grows your max mana, and eventually gives some movement speed. Helps Phase keep casting without running out of mana.
phase.crest|Obelisk: An empowered basic attack; if the target dies soon after, you collect a Soul that makes this attack stronger and adds magical power. Save it to finish low targets.
phase.crest|Leafsong: Gives nearby allies speed, immunity to slows and lets them pass through heroes. Use it to engage or escape with your linked ally; it also adds a ward.

serath.augment|Crushing Descent: Ascend now briefly stuns what it lands on. A 0.2s stun is short, but it can interrupt a dash or channel as you dive in to start the fight.
serath.Eternal|Thraex: The last hero you basic attack takes more damage from you and deals less to you. It favors locking onto one target and staying on them with Chastise resets.
serath.minor|Savage Strikes: Extra physical damage on each hit that ramps against heroes and heals you. Chastise applies on-hit to everyone it hits, so it spreads this to a group.
serath.minor|Ferocity: Attack speed that keeps stacking the longer you stay in hero combat. It rewards long fights, especially during Heresy when you are attacking nonstop.
serath.crest|Liberator: Removes every debuff and gives you a shield. Save it to break the crowd control that lands on you after Heaven's Fury or Ascend puts you in the middle.
serath.augment|Vital Resonance: Picking up a Fallen Grace visage after a takedown now heals you a lot. Grabbing visages in a teamfight gives a free Heresy plus health to keep fighting.
serath.Eternal|Weald: Damaging a hero below 30% health fires true-damage missiles that pass through walls, 10s cooldown per hero. Bonus attack speed, like Heresy's, adds more missiles to finish fleeing targets.
serath.minor|Forage: Plain extra gold and XP from minions and monsters; a farming boost with nothing special for her kit.
serath.minor|Taproot: Basic attacks heal a little, scaling with bonus physical power. Helps sustain while clearing camps and during Heresy's fast attacks.
serath.crest|Eviscerator: Attack faster, heal from all damage, and add damage to each hit for 6s. Pop it alongside Heresy for a burst of fast, healing on-hit attacks.
serath.augment|Wrath Unleashed: Each on-hit effect on a hero grants stacking attack speed. Chastise and Heaven's Fury both apply on-hit, so combos plus Heresy attacks ramp her attack speed quickly.
serath.minor|Dryad's Boon: There's no game text for this minor in our data, so we can't say what it does for Serath.
serath.minor|Wind-Rider: After a dash, leap or teleport, you attack faster for 4s. Heaven's Fury's final teleport sets it up so you hit hard right after landing.
serath.Eternal|Lotus: Every couple of minutes and every takedown, a random small stat bonus. Generic scaling with nothing special for her kit.
serath.minor|Flawless: Ability hits on heroes heal you and nearby allies a little, once per cast. Small sustain from Chastise, Heaven's Fury and Ascend.
serath.minor|Prima Donna: You deal 10% more damage to heroes but take 6% more. An all-in pick for a Serath who commits with Ascend and needs kills fast.
serath.crest|Judgement: An area hit around you that heals on hero hits. Use it after Ascend or Heaven's Fury drops you into a group.
serath.Eternal|Vermis: Every third basic attack in a row on the same hero deals a chunk of their max health. Chastise resets your attack timer, so you reach the third hit fast, great against tanks.
serath.minor|Serration: Vermis also takes some of the target's missing health. It turns your third hit into a finisher on wounded targets.
serath.minor|Melting Point: Bonus damage against targets with high physical armor. Take it when the enemy front line is stacking armor.
serath.crest|Pacifier: A short dash that empowers your next physical hit, much stronger below 20% health. Use it to catch a fleeing target, and a kill lets you recast it.
serath.Eternal|Satariel: Each takedown makes you stronger in power and attack speed but lowers your max health, and dying loses it all. A snowball pick for a Serath already getting kills with Fallen Grace.
serath.minor|Demonic Bargain: Plain extra gold at levels 1 and 10; a generic economy boost.
serath.minor|Rite: Each ability cast costs some health, but your ability cooldowns get permanently faster. More Chastise and Heaven's Fury casts, paid for in health.

shinbi.augment|Allegro: Rushing Beat comes back faster, so you get more dashes to dive in, chain ability hits for All-Kill stacks, and still keep a charge to escape.
shinbi.Eternal|Vesh: Every ability hit leaves a short burn on the target. Shinbi lands wolves and dashes constantly, so Line Tempo, Circle Rhythm and Rushing Beat all add extra damage after the combo ends.
shinbi.minor|Lich: Your magic damage heals you, and it grows as you level. Spinning Circle Rhythm and spamming Line Tempo in a fight keeps you topped up while you dive.
shinbi.minor|Mind Rot: Vesh's burn also chips a slice of the target's current health, so it hits hardest early in a fight against healthy, beefy targets before your All-Kill finishes them.
shinbi.crest|Tempest: Pop it as you dive: it zaps up to 3 nearby heroes every second and heals you, which pairs with Circle Rhythm's shield to keep Shinbi alive in the middle of a fight.
shinbi.augment|Crescendo: Your last basic attack in the chain hits harder as magic damage, rewarding weaving basic attacks between abilities in lane trades instead of pure ability spam.
shinbi.Eternal|Aion: Every spell cast boosts mana regen for a while and your ability damage on heroes earns gold. Shinbi casts a lot, so it fuels both her mana and her item timings.
shinbi.minor|Philosopher: Generic gold over time; it ticks a little faster with more ability cooldown reduction. Nothing special with the kit.
shinbi.minor|Arcane Resonance: With Aion's mana regen stacked from spamming abilities, your basic ability cooldowns tick faster, so Line Tempo and Rushing Beat come back sooner mid-fight.
shinbi.minor|Runic Focus: More magic power while your mana bar is high. Open fights with full mana for the biggest burst, then it fades as you spend mana on your combo.
shinbi.crest|Obelisk: An empowered basic attack you use to finish low targets. Securing kills grows its damage and your magic power over the game, so it rewards a snowballing assassin.
shinbi.augment|Encore: If a marked enemy dies while the All-Kill wolves are on them, your ultimate resets. Use it in team fights to chain kills across several marked enemies.

grux.augment|Red Mist: Every nearby enemy hero with your bleed on them speeds up your attacks. In team fights, spread Double Pain hits across several targets to swing much faster.
grux.Eternal|Vermis: Every third basic attack on the same hero deals bonus damage based on their max health. Grux sticks to targets with Stampede and Smash 'n Grab, so it shreds tanks.
grux.minor|Crush: Stunning a hero adds bonus damage from their max health. Smash 'n Grab and Warlord's Challenge both trigger it, so every pull or stun hurts more.
grux.minor|Sub-Surface: Take less damage from area abilities. Generic tankiness for diving into the backline; nothing special with the kit.
grux.crest|Iceskorn Talons: Drops an ice sheet for 8s that slows enemies on it by 10% and gives allies on it physical power and move speed. Drop it where Smash 'n Grab pulls enemies so your team fights on it.
grux.augment|Lust For Blood: Once a target has full bleed stacks, you heal off all damage you deal to them. Build stacks with basic attacks, then Double Pain heals you in long duels.
grux.Eternal|Marrow: You heal off damage to heroes, more when you are low. Grux wants to stay in the fight, and Double Pain's own healing stacks on top.
grux.minor|Taste of Iron: Your bleed counts as damage over time, so once it ticks on a hero all your damage goes up. Grux keeps it active just by hitting.
grux.minor|Roses: Takedowns give extra gold that grows with each one, and kills make Marrow heal more for a while. Generic snowball gold plus more sustain after kills.
grux.Eternal|Thraex: The hero you basic attack takes more damage from you and deals less to you. Great for Grux's one-on-one duels once Stampede drags them in.
grux.minor|Savage Strikes: Small extra damage on every hit that grows while you keep hitting heroes, and heals you. Double Pain applies on-hit effects twice, so it triggers extra.
grux.minor|Ferocity: The longer you stay in a fight, the faster you attack, without a cap. Rewards Grux for staying on target through Warlord's Challenge.
grux.Eternal|Xyris: Bonus damage that grows as you kill minions and monsters. A generic farming damage boost; nothing special with the kit.
grux.minor|Iron Will: Heals you for a bit of your basic attack damage. Small sustain that adds up during Warlord's Challenge's fast attacks.
grux.minor|Eviscerate: More damage to targets that are nearly full health. Helps your opening Stampede and Smash 'n Grab combo hit harder.
grux.crest|Judgement: An area hit around you that heals you on hero hits. Use it in the middle of a fight after Stampede to top up while trading.
grux.crest|Sanctification: Shields you and nearby allies, and crowd control on them wears off faster while the shield holds. Pop it as you dive so stuns cut your combo short for less time.
grux.minor|Jealousy: You deal more damage as your health drops. Fits Grux's habit of brawling at low health while Double Pain and Marrow heal him back.
grux.minor|Serration: Vermis's third-hit bonus also deals damage based on the target's missing health, so it finishes wounded heroes faster.
grux.crest|Eviscerator: Short burst of attack speed, healing on damage and extra hit damage. Pop it with Warlord's Challenge for a huge flurry of bleed-stacking hits.

kallari.augment|Deadly Finesse: Crippling Dagger hits on heroes or kills shorten its cooldown and refund mana. With two charges she can throw daggers far more often to poke and finish minions.
kallari.Eternal|Lotus: Random small stat boosts every couple of minutes and on each takedown. Generic slow scaling, nothing special with Kallari's abilities.
kallari.minor|Early Bloom: Grants a free extra level at level 12. Generic power spike, nothing tied to Kallari's abilities.
kallari.minor|Immaculate: She takes less damage while near full health. Helps survive the first burst when she jumps in from Shadow Walk.
kallari.crest|Nex: Damage she deals stores up, then Reap dashes and hits nearby heroes harder for it. Use it right after Shadow Dance and Guillotine to finish a target.
kallari.augment|Execution Mandate: Takedowns cut her current basic ability cooldowns sharply, so after a kill she can Shadow Walk and Shadow Dance again quickly to escape or reach the next target.
kallari.Eternal|Vesh: Part of each ability's damage to heroes burns over time, adding to Death Mark's delayed hit. Helps finish targets that escape her combo.
kallari.minor|The Tenth Seal: At level 10, Guillotine hits a bit harder and comes back sooner.
kallari.minor|Millennia: Guillotine slowly gets stronger every minute of the game. A late-game pick, nothing for the early fights.
kallari.crest|Assassin Crest: Ability hits and kills restore small amounts of health, and after enough healing it upgrades at base. A starter crest that grows into a stronger one later.
kallari.augment|Critical Override: Her abilities can critically strike, at reduced crit damage. Pairs with a crit build so Crippling Dagger, Shadow Dance and Guillotine can all spike.
kallari.minor|Masterpiece: Kills give stacking bonus damage and speed for a while, helping her chain one kill into the next.
kallari.minor|Prima Donna: More damage to heroes, but she takes more damage too. Fits an assassin who strikes from Camouflage and gets out before being hit back.
kallari.crest|Ortus: A burst of speed and physical power; takedowns during it grant permanent power and refresh it. Activate right before Shadow Dance to jump a target.

howitzer.augment|Sniper Shells: Each basic attack stacks attack speed and omnivamp, up to 5 times. Omnivamp heals you from all damage, abilities included, so keep firing between abilities in lane to trade and heal back.
howitzer.Eternal|Thraex: Your basic attacks mark the hero you hit: more damage to them, less from them. Good in lane trades where you keep shooting one target.
howitzer.minor|The King: Basic attacks on heroes give you gold. Poke the enemy laner with your cannon to get ahead in items.
howitzer.minor|Ferocity: Attack speed keeps climbing for every second you stay in a hero fight. Helps an attack-focused Howitzer in long fights.
howitzer.crest|Typhoon: Basic attacks stack attack speed, and full stacks give a short dash. Fits a Howitzer who fights with his cannon and needs to reposition.
howitzer.minor|Savage Strikes: Each basic attack adds a bit of physical damage that grows while you keep hitting a hero, and heals you for it. Small lane sustain for a cannon-focused Howitzer.
howitzer.crest|Epoch: Your panic button. When a diver jumps you, freeze yourself to wait out their burst, then Land Mine them away.
howitzer.Eternal|Idrisil: Extra armor while healthy, and dropping low turns it into a shield. Gives an immobile mage more time to escape when caught.
howitzer.minor|Cold Hearted: Enemies who attack you get slowed a little. Makes it easier to walk away from melee divers.
howitzer.minor|Icy Touch: Your basic attacks slow the enemy's attacks. Helps you win trades against attack-based laners.
howitzer.crest|Pacifier: Dash a short way, and your next physical hit deals extra damage, much more on nearly dead heroes. Extra mobility for a hero who has little.
howitzer.Eternal|Lotus: Generic: every 2 minutes and every takedown you get a random small boost to damage, cooldowns, speed or health. Nothing specific to Howitzer.
howitzer.minor|Masterpiece: Each kill gives stacking bonus damage and movement speed for a short time. Make It Rain can pick up several kills, which stacks it fast.
howitzer.minor|Prima Donna: You deal more damage to heroes but take more from everything. A risky boost for a hero who already has little escape.

wukong.augment|Masterful Mimicry: One more max clone, and hair stacks build on their own every 5.5s. You spawn clones even between trades, so fights start with more bodies on your side.
wukong.Eternal|Krix: More max health and a bigger body. Wukong dives with Windsurge and Pole Vault, so the extra health helps him survive in the middle, though the larger size is easier to hit.
wukong.minor|Voracity: Kills on any unit restore a bit of health and give a little gold. Generic sustain while farming camps, nothing special with his kit.
wukong.minor|Feeding Frenzy: More attack speed for each enemy hero near you. In teamfights it stacks on top of Pole Vault, so your hits, and new clones, come much faster.
wukong.crest|Exodus: Lob it to briefly stun and knock a hero back; for 1s they take 20% more damage from you. Follow straight up with High Impact or the Cyclebreaker stun.
wukong.Eternal|Lotus: Every couple of minutes and every takedown, a random small stat bonus. Generic scaling with nothing special for his kit.
wukong.minor|Flawless: Ability hits on heroes heal you and nearby allies a little, once per cast. Small sustain from Windsurge, Force Push and Cyclebreaker.
wukong.minor|Fragrance: More magical and true damage to nearby heroes. Wukong deals physical damage, so this does very little for him.
wukong.crest|Judgement: An area hit around you that heals on hero hits. Use it after High Impact slams you into a group for burst plus a heal.
wukong.Eternal|Thraex: The last hero you basic attack takes more damage from you and deals less to you. Pole Vault's attack speed lets you keep a duel target marked.
wukong.minor|Alpha's Court: Bonus damage when no allied hero is within 800 units. Fits a Wukong who jungles, splits a lane or duels with his clones instead of grouping.
wukong.minor|Ferocity: Attack speed that keeps stacking the longer you stay in hero combat. Rewards long brawls, and faster attacks also spawn clones sooner from 84000 Hairs.
wukong.crest|Nex: A dash that hits nearby heroes and slows, stronger after you have stored damage. Use it mid-fight once your combo has landed to re-engage or chase.

khaimera.augment|Lane Lurker: Hitting minions now builds Rage, so you can walk into a fight already charged and your cooldowns tick faster from the first swing. The trade is weaker passive healing early, so you sustain less in lane before level 16.
khaimera.Eternal|Thraex: Your basic attacks mark whoever you are hitting, so once Unleash starts its flurry you deal more to that target and take less back from them. Best in long one-on-one brawls against a single diver.
khaimera.minor|Alpha's Court: Extra damage when no ally is near you, which fits Khaimera's habit of jumping in alone with Ambush to pick off a stray target. It switches off in grouped teamfights.
khaimera.minor|Ferocity: Your attack speed keeps climbing the longer you stay in a hero fight, which feeds more Rage and faster cooldowns. Pays off in drawn-out brawls, does little in quick burst trades.
khaimera.crest|Judgement: Hit it after Ambush lands you in the middle of the enemy: it hits everyone around you and heals you per hero hit, topping you up while you wait for Invigorate.
khaimera.augment|Feral Ambush: Ambush reaches a bit farther, so you can start fights or finish a fleeing low target from a safer distance. Since Ambush hits harder on wounded enemies, the extra reach mostly wins chases.
khaimera.minor|Savage Strikes: Small extra damage and healing on every hit that grows while you keep attacking a hero. Unleash's fast flurry stacks it quickly, giving steady sustain in extended fights.
khaimera.crest|Iceskorn Talons: Drops an ice field where you fight: allies on it hit harder and move faster, enemies on it are slowed. Use it as you Ambush in so your follow-up team can stick to targets.
khaimera.augment|Jungle Invasion: Plain bonus physical power while you are in the jungle, doubled in the enemy jungle. It rewards invading and fighting over the other team's camps rather than any specific ability.
khaimera.Eternal|Knell: Every hit and ability strips some of the target's armor and gives it to you. Khaimera's Unleash flurry and Cull's six hits stack it fast, so you deal more and take less in extended fights.
khaimera.minor|Frequency: Each armor-shred stack on a target also raises your attack speed and lowers ability cooldowns. With Unleash and basic attacks keeping stacks up, your whole rotation comes back faster.
khaimera.minor|Peal: Lower ultimate cooldown, and casting Cull instantly applies full armor shred to everything you hit for a short while. Your post-Cull flurry lands against already-softened targets.
khaimera.Eternal|Lotus: A random small stat bonus every couple of minutes and on every takedown. It does nothing specific with Khaimera's kit; it just snowballs a little if you get kills.
khaimera.minor|Early Bloom: One extra level at level 12, so your ability ranks and Cull rank come a little earlier. A generic power bump, nothing special with the kit.
khaimera.minor|Immaculate: Damage reduction while you are near full health, so the opening Ambush dive hurts you less. Once you drop below that, it stops helping.
khaimera.crest|Razorback: Pop it as you dive in: a short burst of armor plus reflected damage back at heroes hitting you. Good when the enemy team turns to focus you after Ambush.
khaimera.Eternal|Demiurge: Your items give more stats and their effects hit harder. A generic scaling boost that does nothing special with Khaimera's abilities.
khaimera.minor|Bio-Mechanical Fusion: Converts magical power into physical power. Khaimera's Unleash already uses magical power for extra attacks, so a hybrid build gets value twice from the same stat.
khaimera.minor|Bloatware: A little more damage and damage reduction for every item you own. Generic late-game scaling, nothing tied to the kit.
khaimera.crest|Winter's Fury: Throws a growing zone that slows and damages enemies inside. On Khaimera it is a catch tool to stop a target running before Ambush comes back; the magical damage boost helps magic-damage allies more than you.
khaimera.crest|Eviscerator: Extra attack speed, lifesteal on everything and empowered basic attacks for a short window. Use it with Unleash for a burst of fast, healing hits on one target.
khaimera.Eternal|Idrisil: Extra armor while healthy, and a shield when you drop low. Pairs with Invigorate as a second safety net when you dive deep and get focused.
khaimera.minor|Cold Hearted: Enemies who basic attack you get slowed a little, stacking. Helps against attack-speed carries trying to fight you, but not against ability damage.
khaimera.minor|Icy Touch: Your basic attacks lower the enemy's attack speed, stacking. Unleash's flurry stacks it instantly, so you win more trades against other auto-attackers.
khaimera.crest|Nyr Warboots: A burst of decaying move speed plus fast healing for a few seconds. Use it to reach a target after Ambush is spent, or to escape and recover.
khaimera.Eternal|Krix: More max health and a bigger body. Plain tankiness for a diving bruiser; it also makes Invigorate heal more since it heals a share of max health.
khaimera.minor|Voracity: Killing any unit heals you a bit and gives a little gold. Helps sustain through jungle clears; little effect in hero fights.
khaimera.minor|Cannibalism: Each takedown adds permanent max health. Rewards a Khaimera who gets early kills; it does nothing special with the kit beyond more health.
khaimera.Eternal|Weald: When you hit a hero below 30% health, missiles fire that pass through walls. With Ambush already hitting harder on wounded targets, it helps finish low enemies who try to run.
khaimera.minor|Dryad's Boon: No game text is available for Dryad's Boon yet, so its exact effect can't be confirmed. Judge it by its pick rate and win rate rather than a described interaction.
khaimera.minor|Wind-Rider: Leaping with Ambush gives you bonus attack speed right after landing, so your first hits on the target come in faster and build Rage quickly.
khaimera.minor|Masterpiece: Each kill gives a short stacking boost to damage and move speed. Helps Khaimera chain from one low target to the next in a won fight.
khaimera.minor|Forage: Extra gold and XP from minions and monsters. A plain farming boost for the jungle, nothing tied to the kit.
khaimera.Eternal|Exarch: Healing yourself, like with Invigorate or lifesteal, gives a short window of extra attack speed and magical on-hit damage. Pop Invigorate mid-fight and keep swinging.
khaimera.minor|Preservation: Healing and shields you receive are 10% stronger, which boosts Invigorate's heal and any lifesteal you build.
khaimera.minor|Fervour: Basic attacks on heroes heal you and nearby allies a little. Unleash's fast hits trigger it often, but the amount is small.
khaimera.minor|Revelation: Each ability cast trims the cooldown of your other basic abilities. Cycling Ambush, Unleash and Invigorate gets them back slightly sooner.
khaimera.minor|Illumination: Health regeneration equal to your bonus mana regeneration. Khaimera rarely builds mana regeneration, so this adds little for him.

greystone.augment|Tainted Oath: Your Sacred Oath cleave also cuts the healing of everyone it hits. Pick it into healers or lifesteal heroes and land the empowered swing on the whole group.
greystone.Eternal|Krix: Raises your max health as you level and makes you bigger. Greystone's passive regen and ultimate heal scale with max health, so you get tankier overall.
greystone.minor|Voracity: Killing minions or monsters heals a little and gives a bit of gold. Generic lane sustain; nothing special with the kit.
greystone.minor|Feeding Frenzy: You attack faster for every enemy hero near you. Leap in with Assault The Gates and your basic attacks speed up right away.
greystone.crest|Saphir's Mantle: Briefly grows your health and size and damages nearby heroes, then keeps part of that as permanent health. Pop it after leaping in with Assault The Gates.
greystone.minor|Regenerative Tissue: Heals you over time once you go a while without hero damage. Generic lane sustain on top of your passive regen.
greystone.crest|Judgement: An area hit around you that heals you on hero hits. Use it with Make Way in the middle of a fight to top up.
greystone.augment|Close Cut: Make Way hits the nearest enemy harder. Stand on your target with the whirlwind to get the most from it.
greystone.crest|Iceskorn Talons: Drops an ice sheet that slows enemies and speeds up and powers up allies. Drop it after Assault The Gates so enemies stay slowed inside your Make Way whirlwind.
greystone.Eternal|Vermis: Every third basic attack on the same hero deals bonus damage based on their max health. Sacred Oath counts as a basic attack, so weave it in against tanks.
greystone.minor|Serration: Vermis's third-hit bonus also deals damage based on missing health, finishing wounded targets faster.
greystone.minor|Melting Point: More damage only against targets with over 125 physical armor. Make Way's shred lowers their armor, which can drop them under that line, so take it only into heavy-armor tanks.
greystone.augment|Imperial Soul: Stone Forged Soul hits harder in a bigger area. Use it in the middle of the enemy team to slow and crush as many as possible.
greystone.minor|Cannibalism: Each takedown permanently adds a bit of max health. Generic tankiness that grows with your kills.
greystone.Eternal|Thraex: The hero you basic attack takes more damage from you and deals less to you. Great in Greystone's long side-lane duels.
greystone.minor|Savage Strikes: Small extra damage on every hit that grows while you keep hitting heroes, and heals you. Helps in long trades.
greystone.minor|Ferocity: The longer you stay in a fight, the faster you attack, with no cap. Fits Greystone's long brawls.
greystone.Eternal|Knell: Your hits strip the enemy's armor and give you some of it. Stacks with Make Way's armor shred, so your physical damage hits much harder.
greystone.minor|Patina: A shield and a bit of movement speed after a while without damage. Generic lane safety; nothing special with the kit.
greystone.minor|Fracture: More damage against targets carrying full armor-shred stacks from Knell. Make Way and basic attacks keep stacks on.
greystone.crest|Leafsong: Speeds up nearby allies and makes them immune to slows. Use it to chase or escape as a team; it also gives an extra ward.
greystone.minor|Frequency: Each Rust stack from Knell on enemies gives you attack speed and ability haste. Keep hitting with Make Way and basic attacks to hold the stacks so Make Way and Sacred Oath come back faster.
greystone.Eternal|Nihil: Staying in fights with heroes builds up power and armor over time, and level-ups or takedowns make it permanently stronger. Fits Greystone's long duels.
greystone.minor|From the Abyss: Heals a share of your max health every second while fighting heroes or hidden, on top of your passive regen.
greystone.minor|Adaptive Plating: Getting hit gives you armor of the matching type. Helps Greystone soak damage when he leaps into the enemy team.
greystone.crest|Razorback: Briefly more armor, and part of the damage heroes deal to you hits them back. Pop it when the enemy team focuses you after Assault The Gates.

zarus.augment|The Ascended: Plain health and physical power that grow every minute of the game. Nothing tied to the kit; it just rewards long games.
zarus.Eternal|Xyris: Bonus damage that grows as you kill units through the game. Plain scaling for a farming fighter, nothing tied to the kit.
zarus.minor|Furor: A burst of attack speed when you enter hero combat. Stacks with Evade's attack speed for a fast opening after you dash in.
zarus.minor|Cull the Weak: Extra damage to minions and monsters, and mana back on kills. A plain farming boost for clearing waves and camps.
zarus.crest|Saphir's Mantle: Grow and gain max health for a few seconds while damaging heroes near you, then keep some health permanently. Pop it as you go in with Coliseum to soak the fight.
zarus.augment|Flow State: Evade comes back sooner and resets on every takedown. Dash in for the kill, then Evade again right away to chase the next target or escape.
zarus.Eternal|Lotus: A random small stat bonus every couple of minutes and on every takedown. Nothing specific to Zarus's kit.
zarus.minor|Early Bloom: One extra level at level 12, so Coliseum and your ability ranks come a little earlier. A generic power bump.
zarus.minor|Immaculate: Damage reduction while you are near full health, so your opening trade hurts you less. Pairs with Barricade's block to start fights safely.
zarus.crest|Judgement: Damages everyone around you and heals you for each hero hit. Use it in melee range after Evade or Coliseum lands you on the enemy.
zarus.Eternal|Demiurge: Your items give more stats and their effects hit harder. A generic scaling boost, nothing tied to the kit.
zarus.minor|Construct: Health and ability cooldown reduction every level. A plain stat boost, nothing special with the kit.
zarus.minor|Bloatware: A little more damage and damage reduction for every item you own. Generic late-game scaling.
zarus.augment|Master Of Spears: A full Spear of Nyr throw no longer costs a much longer cooldown. Throw the long-range spear more freely to poke and to execute low targets instead of only using the quick thrust.
zarus.Eternal|Thraex: Your basic attacks mark the target, so you deal more to them and take less back. Strong inside Coliseum, where you fight one target up close.
zarus.minor|Alpha's Court: Extra damage when no ally is near you. Fits Zarus dueling one target in Coliseum or a side lane, not grouped fights.
zarus.minor|Ferocity: Attack speed that keeps climbing the longer you stay in hero combat. Rewards long brawls where Gladiator stays maxed.

skylar.augment|Assault MK-II: Air Assault hovers longer and fires extra missiles with each attack. Hover over fights to rain more damage from a safer angle.
skylar.Eternal|Vermis: Every third basic attack on the same hero deals bonus damage based on their max health. Skylar attacks fast, so it triggers often against tanks.
skylar.minor|Serration: Vermis's third-hit bonus also deals damage based on missing health, finishing wounded targets faster.
skylar.minor|Breach: Atomiser strips a big chunk of the target's armor for a few seconds. Fire it to open a fight so your follow-up hits land much harder.
skylar.crest|Pacifier: A short dash and an empowered hit that deals extra damage to low targets, and resets on a kill. Use it to finish fleeing enemies.
skylar.Eternal|Weald: When you damage a hero below 30% health, 4 true-damage missiles fly at them through walls, more with bonus attack speed. Helps finish targets escaping you.
skylar.minor|Forage: Extra gold and XP from minions and monsters. Generic farming boost; nothing special with the kit.
skylar.minor|Barkskin: Enemy heroes that basic attack you take a little damage back. Small help against melee divers; nothing special with the kit.
skylar.crest|Eviscerator: Short burst of attack speed, healing on damage and extra hit damage. Pop it with Hypercharge for a strong damage window.
skylar.augment|Plasma Barrage: Sticking Plasma Grenade on a hero refunds part of its cooldown, and the blast deals extra damage based on missing health. Throw it often in fights.
skylar.Eternal|Xyris: Bonus damage that grows as you kill minions and monsters. A generic farming damage boost; nothing special with the kit.
skylar.minor|Iron Will: Heals you for a bit of your basic attack damage. Small sustain while you attack.
skylar.minor|Bone Collector: After enough kills of minions and monsters, you permanently gain critical chance. A farming payoff for crit builds.
skylar.minor|Furor: Short attack speed boost when a fight starts. Helps your opening attacks before Hypercharge.
skylar.crest|Liberator: Removes crowd control and other debuffs and gives a shield. Save it for the stun or slow that would let divers kill you.
skylar.Eternal|Thraex: The hero you basic attack takes more damage from you and deals less to you. Good for steady damage on one target.
skylar.minor|Savage Strikes: Small extra damage on every hit that grows while you keep hitting heroes, and heals you.
skylar.minor|Rallying Roar: Atomiser comes back a bit sooner, and firing it speeds up you and nearby allies. Use it to start a chase or reposition.
skylar.Eternal|Satariel: Takedowns make you stronger and faster attacking, but lower your max health, and you lose it all on death. Only take it if you can stay safe in fights.
skylar.minor|Demonic Bargain: Extra gold at two levels for faster items. Generic gold; nothing special with the kit.
skylar.minor|Broken Wings: Your movement speed cannot be changed by items or abilities, so slows do nothing but neither do speed boosts. A niche pick into heavy slows.
skylar.minor|Melting Point: More damage to targets with lots of armor. A pick into tanky teams; Hypercharge already ignores some armor.
skylar.Eternal|Lotus: Gives you a random small stat every couple of minutes and on takedowns. Generic slow scaling; nothing special with the kit.
skylar.minor|Masterpiece: Kills give you stacking damage and movement speed for a while. Helps chain kills in team fights.
skylar.minor|Prima Donna: You deal more damage to heroes but take more damage. Only worth it if you can keep your distance.
skylar.minor|Dryad's Boon: No game text is available for this minor yet, so we can't say what it does for Skylar.
skylar.minor|Taproot: Basic attacks heal you a little, more with bonus physical power. Small lane sustain.
skylar.minor|Wind-Rider: Dashes and leaps give a burst of attack speed. Pairs with Air Assault and dash crests to attack faster right after you reposition.
skylar.crest|Exodus: A grenade that knocks enemy heroes back and makes them take more damage from you. Use it to push divers off you or into your team.
skylar.Eternal|Knell: Your hits strip the enemy's armor and give you some of it. Skylar hits often, so stacks build quickly on your target.
skylar.minor|Frequency: Each armor-shred stack you keep on enemies gives you attack speed and shorter ability cooldowns.
skylar.minor|Resonant Repair: When you get stunned or rooted, you heal a bit and shrug off crowd control faster. Helps survive divers who lock you down.
skylar.Eternal|Demiurge: Makes all your item stats and item effects stronger. Generic power boost; nothing special with the kit.
skylar.minor|Construct: Extra health and ability cooldown reduction every level. Generic stats; nothing special with the kit.
skylar.minor|Bloatware: More damage and damage reduction for each item you own. A generic late-game boost; nothing special with the kit.

renna.augment|Netherward: Every Soulfire cast gives you a short shield. Since Soulfire is your most frequent ability, it adds steady protection during trades.
renna.Eternal|Demiurge: Your items give more stats and item effects hit harder. A general power boost; nothing tied to her kit.
renna.minor|Construct: Plain extra health and ability cooldown speed every level. Generic stats with no special kit interaction.
renna.minor|Memory Leak: Each cast permanently adds a little max mana, and you gain move speed once it builds up. Rewards casting often.
renna.crest|Epoch: Enter stasis for 2.5s, unable to act. Use it to dodge burst after Abyssal Rift teleports you into danger.
renna.Eternal|Aion: Each cast stacks mana regen, and ability damage to heroes gives gold. Poking with Soulfire and Stupor funds your items.
renna.minor|Sacrifice: Ability hits on heroes restore mana, and hero kills restore more. Keeps you casting during long fights.
renna.minor|Arcane Resonance: Your basic ability cooldowns get faster based on mana regen. Pairs with Aion's regen stacks to cast Soulfire and Stupor more often.
renna.Eternal|Lotus: Every couple of minutes and every takedown, a random small stat bonus. Generic scaling with nothing special for her kit.
renna.minor|Early Bloom: An extra level when you reach level 12. Gets your next ability ranks sooner; otherwise generic.
renna.minor|Prima Donna: You deal 10% more damage to heroes but take 6% more. A glass cannon pick for a Renna who stays back.
renna.Eternal|Vesh: Ability damage on heroes leaves a small burn that grows with game time. Soulfire, Mortal Coil and Abyssal Rift damage all feed it.
renna.minor|Lich: Magical lifesteal that grows with level. Mortal Coil, Stupor's bonus damage and Abyssal Rift deal magical damage, so it heals you during fights.
renna.minor|Millennia: Your ultimate's damage slowly grows over time. A small late-game boost to Abyssal Rift.
renna.crest|Soulbearer: A shield plus magical lifesteal and move speed for 8s. Use it before Abyssal Rift to survive while the singularity fires.
renna.minor|Flawless: Ability hits on heroes heal you and nearby allies a little, once per cast. Small team sustain from Soulfire and Stupor poke.
renna.minor|Fragrance: More magical and true damage to nearby heroes. Mortal Coil and Abyssal Rift deal magical damage, so it helps when you fight close.
renna.augment|Vital Essence: Picking up Essence gives gold and restores some missing health and mana. Fights where heroes die near you refill you as you collect.
renna.minor|Phylactery: After your ultimate, your cooldowns tick much faster and you gain a shield for 4s. Abyssal Rift becomes a window to recast Soulfire and Stupor quickly.

murdock.augment|Justice's Reach: Shots Fired, the empowered shot after 5 basic attacks, pierces through units and reaches even further. Poke heroes standing behind their minion wave.
murdock.Eternal|Vermis: Every third basic attack on the same hero adds damage based on their max health. Murdock's basic-attack focus makes this a steady boost, best into tanks.
murdock.minor|Serration: Adds missing-health damage on top of Vermis procs, helping finish hurt targets.
murdock.minor|Melting Point: Extra damage only into enemies with over 125 physical armor. Buckshot's shred lowers their armor and can drop them below that line, so this is a pick into heavy tanks only.
murdock.crest|Pacifier: A short dash that empowers your next physical hit, much stronger on targets below 20% health. Dash in and finish a low target with a basic attack or Buckshot.
murdock.Eternal|Weald: Hitting a hero below 30% health fires shots through walls. A finisher for enemies fleeing out of range.
murdock.minor|Natural Resistance: Below 25% health you cleanse crowd control and resist more. A bail-out for when Murdock gets caught by a dive.
murdock.minor|Barkskin: Enemies who basic attack you take a little damage back. Mostly helps in lane trades against other attackers.
murdock.crest|Liberator: Removes slows, stuns and other debuffs and gives a short shield. Save it for when you get caught, then Hot Pursuit away or keep shooting.
murdock.augment|Sting Operation: More Static Trap charges and larger traps. Seed bushes, objectives and escape routes with roots to protect yourself and set up picks.
murdock.minor|Sub-Surface: Take less damage from area abilities. A defensive pick for team fights full of AoE.
murdock.crest|Iceskorn Talons: Creates an ice sheet that boosts allies' power and speed and slows enemies. Pop it in a team fight to help everyone chase or hold ground.
murdock.Eternal|Xyris: Bonus damage that grows as you kill minions and monsters. A farming payoff for a carry who clears waves.
murdock.minor|Furor: Entering a hero fight grants a burst of attack speed. Combined with Hot Pursuit it front-loads Murdock's damage.
murdock.minor|Bone Collector: After enough minion and monster kills, permanently gain critical strike chance. A farm-then-scale pick for basic-attack Murdock.
murdock.Eternal|Lotus: Random small boosts every few minutes and on takedowns: damage, ability cooldowns, speed or health. A generic scaling pick.
murdock.minor|Masterpiece: Kills give stacking damage and speed for a short time. Hot Pursuit also resets on takedowns, so Murdock can chase from one kill to the next.
murdock.minor|Prima Donna: More damage to heroes, more damage taken. Fits Murdock staying at max range; punishing if he gets caught.
murdock.minor|Forage: Plain economy: a bit more gold and XP from each minion or monster kill.
murdock.minor|Taproot: Each basic attack heals a little, scaling with bonus physical power. Light sustain for lane trades.
murdock.augment|Martial Law: Long Arm of the Law hits harder and gives bonus gold on hero kills. Look for global ult finishes on low enemies anywhere on the map.
murdock.crest|Eviscerator: A burst of attack speed, healing on all damage, and extra on-hit damage for 6s. Stack it with Hot Pursuit's attack speed for a big damage window.

scarlett.augment|Volcaic Slam: When an outer-edge Ashen Vow hit empowers your next Cindara, that lantern slam also leaves a rupture that erupts and slows. It gives your Ashen Vow into Cindara combo a second hit and makes it hard to walk out of.
scarlett.Eternal|Knell: Every Cindara swing and ability on a hero adds Rust, cutting their armor and adding some to yours. Your fast stab and slam combos hit max Rust quickly, so longer trades against bruisers and tanks swing your way.
scarlett.minor|Patina: A small shield and some move speed come back after you go untouched for 10s. Mostly a lane and roaming comfort piece; it softens the first poke before you dash in with First Intent.
scarlett.minor|Peal: Swan Song comes back sooner, and casting it slaps max Rust on whoever you hit next. Your ultimate strike and the follow-up Minueta stabs land on a target with their armor already shredded.
scarlett.crest|Pacifier: A short dash that empowers your next physical hit, much stronger on a target below 20% health. Pair it with Minueta's finishing stab, which already hits harder on hurt targets, to run down kills.
scarlett.minor|Fracture: Extra damage on anyone carrying max Rust from Knell. Since Scarlett chains stabs, slams and Cindara swings, she reaches max stacks fast, so this is a steady bonus through every extended trade.
scarlett.crest|Judgement: An area hit around you that heals you when it lands on heroes. Fire it in the middle of an Ashen Vow spin or right after Swan Song lands you in a group, for burst plus a heal.
scarlett.Eternal|Marrow: Heals you for part of your damage to heroes, more the lower your health. Minueta's stabs and Swan Song's strike are big hits, so this keeps a diving Scarlett alive when the fight drags on.
scarlett.minor|Blood Bank: Your recent hero damage turns into extra lifesteal. Minueta's stabs already benefit from lifesteal, so a big combo into a hero makes the rest of your stabs and swings heal more.
scarlett.minor|Roses: Takedowns pay extra gold that grows with each takedown, and hero kills briefly boost Marrow's healing. A snowball piece for a Scarlett who is already winning fights with Swan Song.
scarlett.crest|Liberator: Removes every debuff and gives you a shield. Save it for the slow or stun that would stop your First Intent dash, then go back in.
scarlett.crest|Gravitum: A long-range shot that grounds the first hero hit, stopping their dashes and jumps. Land it on a slippery target first so they cannot escape your First Intent and Swan Song follow-up.
scarlett.augment|Scarlet Dawn: Ability hits, empowered Cindara and the third chain strike all cut First Intent's cooldown, Minueta hits less so. More dashes means more shields and more Energy back, so you can stay in the fight longer.
scarlett.Eternal|Vesh: Ability damage on heroes leaves a small burn that grows with game time. Scarlett's damage comes in bursts from Minueta, Ashen Vow and First Intent, so every combo lingers a little after it lands.
scarlett.minor|Lich: Magical lifesteal, but Scarlett's kit deals physical damage, so this does very little healing for her.
scarlett.minor|Mind Rot: Vesh's burn also takes 2% of the target's current health. Best early against full-health targets when you open with First Intent and Ashen Vow.
scarlett.Eternal|Pilow: You shrink a little, and each ability cast near enemy heroes stacks a debuff that lowers their damage. With quick Minueta and Ashen Vow cooldowns you keep it stacked up while you brawl.
scarlett.minor|Harmonic Currents: Each cast gives back some of your missing health. Scarlett uses Energy, not mana, so the health part is what matters here, and frequent Minueta casts keep it ticking.
scarlett.minor|Neurotoxin: Pilow stacks also make enemies take more damage. Since your Minueta and Ashen Vow keep Pilow stacked, the whole team hits your target harder while you are on them.
scarlett.Eternal|Weald: Hitting a hero below 30% health fires true-damage missiles that pass through walls, 10s cooldown per hero. It helps finish targets that survive a Minueta stab, and bonus attack speed adds more missiles.
scarlett.minor|Forage: Plain extra gold and XP from minions and monsters; nothing special with her kit, just a farming boost.
scarlett.minor|Taproot: Your basic attacks heal a little, scaling with bonus physical power. Cindara's chain swings fast, so it adds up while clearing camps and in long trades.
scarlett.crest|Eviscerator: Pop it to attack faster, heal from all damage, and add damage to each swing for 6s. It speeds up your Cindara chain toward the Energy-restoring third strike in a drawn-out brawl.
scarlett.minor|Dryad's Boon: There's no game text for this minor in our data, so we can't say what it does for Scarlett.
scarlett.minor|Wind-Rider: After a dash, such as First Intent, you attack faster for 4s. It lets the Cindara chain you swing after dashing in reach its third strike quicker.
scarlett.crest|Ortus: Gives move speed and physical power for 7s, and takedowns while it runs grant permanent power. Pop it before committing with First Intent or Swan Song to reach and burst your target.
scarlett.minor|Natural Resistance: Below 25% health you cleanse crowd control and resist it heavily. It saves a low-health Scarlett from being locked down mid-dive so she can still use First Intent's shield to escape.

steel.augment|Heavy Metal: Heavy punches and Shield Bash deal extra magic damage based on his armor, so the tankier Steel builds, the harder they hit. Alternate attacks to reach the heavy punch.
steel.Eternal|Krix: Plain bonus maximum health that grows each level. It also makes his passive Cybernetic Shell shield bigger, since that shield scales with his max health.
steel.minor|Regenerative Tissue: After 8s without hero damage he slowly regenerates health. Safe recovery between lane trades without going back to base.
steel.minor|Cannibalism: Each takedown permanently adds a little max health, which also grows his passive shield. Generic tankiness otherwise.
steel.crest|Sanctification: Shields Steel and nearby allies, and while the shield holds, stuns and slows on them wear off faster. Pop it as he Bull Rushes in so the team follows safely. Also adds an extra ward.
steel.minor|Voracity: Small health and gold refund on each minion or monster kill. Generic lane sustain, nothing tied to Steel's abilities.
steel.crest|Leafsong: Speeds up nearby allies and makes them immune to slows. Use it when engaging with Bull Rush or Shield Slam so the team arrives together. Support crest with an extra ward slot.
steel.Eternal|Idrisil: Extra armor while healthy, then a shield when he drops below 30% health. Keeps him standing after diving in with Shield Slam.
steel.minor|Mending: After taking hero damage, Steel heals back some missing health over a few seconds. Good for soaking pokes in lane and recovering after a trade.
steel.minor|Glacier: Generic magic armor that grows with gold earned. Helps against mage damage, and more armor also boosts Heavy Metal if he runs it.
steel.crest|Saphir's Mantle: Activate to grow bigger, gain max health and damage nearby heroes, then keep some max health permanently. Use it right after Shield Slam lands him among enemies.
steel.minor|Feeding Frenzy: Attacks faster the more enemy heroes are nearby, so he cycles light and heavy punches quicker in teamfights.
steel.crest|Rift Walkers: Dash and pull nearby heroes toward Steel, then follow with Shield Bash or Bull Rush to lock them down. Support crest with an extra ward slot.
steel.Eternal|Nihil: Damaging heroes builds power and armor the longer the fight lasts, growing permanently with levels and takedowns. Suits Steel staying in front through long fights.
steel.minor|From the Abyss: Heals a share of max health each second in hero fights or out of sight. Keeps him frontlining longer.
steel.minor|Adaptive Plating: Taking hits stacks extra armor of the matching type, so Steel gets tougher the longer a fight goes on.
steel.minor|Frost Snap: Bonus damage to stunned or slowed targets. Shield Bash, Shield Slam and Force Shield all set this up for his follow-up hits.
steel.crest|Gamma Gloop: Grounds and slows enemies around Steel. Use it after Bull Rush or Shield Slam to stop enemies escaping before his next stun is ready.

lt-belica.augment|Combat Veteran: Generic: a little movement speed and passive XP that grows with level. Helps Belica reach max ability ranks, where her Innovation bonuses kick in, a bit sooner.
lt-belica.Eternal|Aion: Each spell cast builds mana regen and spell damage to heroes earns gold. Belica casts Void Bomb often, so this keeps her mana up and pays her for poking.
lt-belica.minor|Bottomless Vial: Taking a river buff refills a potion and permanently adds a little magical power. A small sustain and scaling bonus, nothing Belica-specific.
lt-belica.minor|Runic Focus: More magical power while your mana is high. Belica's Void Bomb refunds mana on hits, so landing bombs keeps the bonus up.
lt-belica.crest|Soulbearer: A shield, magical lifesteal and speed for 8s. Pop it before casting Void Bomb and Seismic Assault into a fight to heal off the burst.
lt-belica.minor|Philosopher: Generic: passive gold over time, a bit faster with ability cooldown speed.
lt-belica.augment|Pulsefire Rounds: Her SMG basic attacks deal extra on-hit damage that scales with her power. Makes basic attacks between Void Bomb casts worth more, and suits an attack-focused build.
lt-belica.Eternal|Thraex: The last hero you shot is marked: you deal more to them and take less from them. Only worthwhile if Belica is basic attacking a lot.
lt-belica.minor|Savage Strikes: Basic attacks deal a little extra damage that grows when you keep hitting heroes, and you heal for it. Fits an attack-focused Belica.
lt-belica.minor|Ferocity: Attack speed builds the longer you stay in a hero fight. Only useful for a Belica who leans on her SMG.
lt-belica.crest|Typhoon: Basic attacks stack attack speed, and at full stacks you dash. Gives attack-focused Belica a reposition in longer fights.
lt-belica.Eternal|Vesh: Ability damage to heroes also adds a short burn. Void Bomb, Seismic Assault and the drone zaps all keep ticking after they land.
lt-belica.minor|Tithe of Death: Takedowns restore mana and permanently add ability haste. Once Neural Disruptor is max rank it can also reset on a kill, so fights can snowball into more casts.
lt-belica.minor|Mind Rot: The Vesh burn also deals damage based on the target's current health. Strongest when opening on healthy enemies with Void Bomb.
lt-belica.Eternal|Weald: Hitting a hero below 30% health fires shots through walls. Helps finish targets that escape Neural Disruptor range.
lt-belica.minor|Forage: Plain economy: a bit more gold and XP from each minion or monster kill.
lt-belica.minor|Taproot: Basic attacks heal a little, scaling with bonus physical power. Only meaningful for an attack-focused Belica.
lt-belica.Eternal|Lotus: Random small boosts every few minutes and on takedowns: damage, ability cooldowns, speed or health. A generic scaling pick.
lt-belica.minor|Early Bloom: An extra level at level 12. On Belica that means maxing an ability sooner, unlocking its Innovation bonus and her ability cooldown gain earlier.
lt-belica.minor|Fragrance: More magic damage to nearby heroes. Belica's abilities are short-to-mid range, so this rewards stepping up to land Seismic Assault and Neural Disruptor.
lt-belica.crest|Epoch: Freeze yourself in stasis for 2.5s. Use it after you get dived, letting your drone and allies punish the attackers.
lt-belica.augment|Devastating Bombs: Void Bomb hits harder on enemies standing alone. Aim bombs at a solo laner or someone separated from their team.
lt-belica.minor|Lich: Magical lifesteal that grows with level. Belica's abilities all deal magic damage, so every bomb and wave heals her.
lt-belica.minor|Arcane Resonance: Basic ability cooldowns tick faster the more mana regen you have. Stacks well with Aion, letting Belica cast Void Bomb and Seismic Assault more often.
lt-belica.crest|Leafsong: A support crest: speeds up nearby allies and makes them immune to slows, plus extra wards and less minion gold. For a support Belica starting team fights.
lt-belica.minor|Flawless: Each Belica ability that hits an enemy hero heals Belica and allies within 1000 units for 8 plus 10% of magical power, once per cast. Void Bomb, Seismic Assault and Neural Disruptor all qualify; hitting several heroes still heals once.

eden.augment|Limit Break: Echo: Once you Overheat and cast Limit Break, your stance's basic abilities come back off cooldown at once. Land your ultimate, then immediately chain Q and RMB again for a second full combo.
eden.Eternal|Marrow: Every hit you land on heroes heals you, and the heal grows the lower your health gets. It stacks with melee stance healing, so swapping to claws when hurt lets you out-sustain a close duel.
eden.minor|Blood Bank: Your damage to heroes builds into temporary lifesteal, so Eden's fast ranged rounds and melee chains heal more the longer you keep hitting. Rewards staying in a fight rather than poking.
eden.minor|The Maw: Basic attacks hit harder on enemies below 40% health. Eden's rapid ranged rounds and claw chain both count, so this speeds up finishing a fleeing target.
eden.crest|Pacifier: A short dash that empowers your next physical hit, much stronger on targets below 20% health. Use it to close on a low enemy and finish with Q or a basic attack, then recast after the kill.
eden.augment|Kinetic Waltz: Melee Axiom Strike hits a bit softer but comes back much sooner and gives a burst of speed on hero hits. Built for staying in claw stance and spinning through fights repeatedly.
eden.minor|Jealousy: You deal more damage as your health drops. Pairs with melee stance healing: you can dive in, trade down, and hit harder while the heal brings you back.
eden.crest|Eviscerator: A burst of attack speed, healing on all damage, and extra on-hit damage for 6s. Eden turns attack speed into physical power, so this spikes both her speed and her hit strength in a fight.
eden.Eternal|Vermis: Every third basic attack on the same hero adds damage based on their max health. Eden's ranged gun fires very fast, so it procs constantly, making this strong into tanks.
eden.minor|Serration: Adds missing-health damage on top of Vermis procs. The more you have already hurt the target, the harder each third hit lands, helping finish fights.
eden.minor|Melting Point: Extra damage only into enemies stacked with physical armor. Pick it when the enemy team has tanks building armor; otherwise it does little.
eden.augment|Focal Lens: Landing ranged Q (Tachyon Lance) lowers the target's physical armor and trims its cooldown. Open with the laser so your gun fire and follow-up hit through armor.
eden.Eternal|Thraex: The last hero you shot is marked: you deal more to them and take less from them. Easy to keep up on Eden since her basic attacks hit so often.
eden.minor|Savage Strikes: Basic attacks deal a little extra damage that grows when you keep hitting heroes, and you heal for it. Eden's rapid rounds trigger it many times a second.
eden.minor|Ferocity: Attack speed keeps building the longer you stay in a hero fight. On Eden that also raises physical power through her passive, so long fights favor you.
eden.Eternal|Weald: Hitting a hero below 30% health fires projectiles through walls. A finisher that helps secure kills on enemies trying to escape Eden's gun range.
eden.minor|Forage: Plain economy: a bit more gold and XP from each minion or monster kill.
eden.minor|Taproot: Each basic attack heals a small amount, scaling with bonus physical power. Eden attacks very fast, so the small heals add up in long trades.
eden.crest|Liberator: Removes slows, stuns and other debuffs and gives a short shield. Save it for when you get caught, then keep shooting or swap stance and fight back.
eden.Eternal|Knell: Attacks and abilities stack Rust on heroes, lowering both their armors and giving you some. Eden's fast attacks reach full stacks quickly in any trade.
eden.minor|Patina: A shield and a little speed when you go a while without taking damage. A safety buffer for the first hit in a fight, nothing kit-specific.
eden.minor|Fracture: Extra damage against targets at full Rust stacks. Eden's rapid hits max Rust almost immediately, so this is close to always on in a fight.
eden.minor|Frequency: Each Rust stack on a target gives attack speed and ability cooldown speed. On Eden extra attack speed also turns into physical power, so full Rust ramps her damage.
eden.minor|Alpha's Court: Bonus damage when no ally is nearby. Good for split-pushing or dueling alone; useless when grouped with the team.
eden.minor|Golden Mane: Take less damage from single-target hits and abilities. Helps melee stance Eden survive while she is up close.
eden.minor|Peal: Faster ultimate cooldown, and casting Limit Break applies full Rust for a short time. Overheat, ult, and every hit after it shreds armor immediately.
eden.crest|Witchstalker: Cleanses debuffs and empowers your next hit with damage based on the target's max health, healing you for it. Best into tanks or when cleansing a stun or slow.
eden.minor|Leech: Cuts nearby enemies' natural health regen. Mostly a lane tool to stop them healing back between trades.
eden.minor|Roses: Bonus gold on takedowns that grows with your streak, and hero kills briefly boost Marrow's healing. Rewards snowballing.
eden.Eternal|Xyris: Bonus damage that grows as you kill minions and monsters. A farming payoff: the more Eden clears, the harder everything she does hits.
eden.minor|Iron Will: Heals for part of your basic attack damage, more on critical hits. Eden's constant gunfire keeps it ticking.
eden.minor|Bone Collector: After enough minion and monster kills, permanently gain critical strike chance. A farm-then-scale pick for basic-attack Eden.
eden.minor|Dryad's Boon: No game text is on record for this minor, so we can't say what it does for Eden.
eden.minor|Barkskin: Enemies who basic attack you take a little damage back. Helps against other attackers dueling melee Eden, not much else.
eden.Eternal|Lotus: Random small boosts every few minutes and on takedowns: damage, ability cooldowns, speed or health. A generic scaling pick with no special Eden link.
eden.minor|Early Bloom: Generic: an extra level when you hit level 12.
eden.minor|Prima Donna: You deal more damage to heroes but take more from everything. Fits ranged Eden who can stay back; risky when diving in melee.
eden.minor|Masterpiece: Kills give stacking damage and speed for a short time. Helps Eden chain from one kill into the next in a team fight.
eden.minor|Immaculate: Take less damage while near full health. Makes it safer to poke with ranged stance before committing.
eden.crest|Judgement: Thunder Cleaver deals damage in an area around Eden and heals Eden on a hero hit, with further hero hits healing at 50% strength. Best in melee stance, after Talon Drive puts Eden in close range.

revenant.augment|Quickdraw: Revenant reloads 35% faster after every four shots or when you reload with Hellfire Rounds. Less downtime between crit rounds means steadier damage, and the higher jump helps reposition.
revenant.Eternal|Marrow: Heals you for part of your damage to heroes, more the lower your health. Your crit final rounds and Obliterate missiles hit hard, so this keeps you dueling when low.
revenant.minor|Blood Bank: Recent hero damage turns into extra lifesteal. A big Hellfire round or Obliterate volley makes your next shots heal more.
revenant.minor|Roses: Takedowns pay extra gold that grows per takedown, and kills briefly boost Marrow's healing. It stacks with Bounty Hunter's kill gold, so a fed Revenant snowballs harder.
revenant.crest|Liberator: Removes every debuff and gives you a shield. Use it to break a slow or stun so you can keep firing or escape when divers reach you.
revenant.augment|Hellfire Blast: Your fourth shot, the guaranteed crit, hits harder and ignores some bonus armor. It makes each reload cycle's last round a bigger threat to tanky targets.
revenant.Eternal|Vermis: Every third basic attack in a row on the same hero adds damage based on their max health. Your four-round cylinder fits it naturally, so it shines against tanks.
revenant.minor|Serration: Vermis also takes a slice of the target's missing health, so it combines with Hellfire Rounds' missing-health final shot to finish wounded targets.
revenant.minor|Sub-Surface: Take less damage from area abilities. A defensive pick for when the enemy has big area burst aimed at you.
revenant.minor|Melting Point: Bonus damage against targets with high physical armor. Pick it when tanks or armor-stacking bruisers are your main targets.
revenant.crest|Pacifier: A short dash that empowers your next physical hit, much stronger on a target below 20% health. Dash and fire your final round to execute, and a kill lets you recast it.
revenant.minor|Leech: Enemy heroes near you lose their base health regen. It stops lane opponents from healing back up between your trades.
revenant.Eternal|Xyris: Bonus damage that grows as you kill units. A plain damage boost that rewards farming; nothing special with his kit.
revenant.minor|Iron Will: Your basic attacks heal a little, doubled on critical strikes. Since every final round crits, each reload cycle gives a bigger heal.
revenant.minor|Bone Collector: After enough kills you permanently gain 20% crit chance. Crit chance also raises Bounty Hunter's physical power, so it pays twice for Revenant.
revenant.augment|Spectral Bounty: Kills inside Reckoning pay more Bounty Hunter gold and permanent power. Use Reckoning to isolate a target you can actually kill so the reward snowballs.
revenant.Eternal|Lotus: Every couple of minutes and every takedown, a random small stat bonus. Generic scaling with nothing special for his kit.
revenant.minor|Flawless: Obliterate or Scar hitting a hero heals you and nearby allies a little, once per cast. A small sustain bonus that fits a bot lane with a support.
revenant.minor|Immaculate: Less damage taken while you are near full health. It helps you survive the first poke before you start trading.
revenant.Eternal|Demiurge: Your items give more stats and item effects hit harder. A general power boost that grows as you finish items; nothing tied to his kit.
revenant.minor|Construct: Plain extra health and ability cooldown speed every level. Generic stats with no special kit interaction.
revenant.minor|Cursed Corrupted: Trades crit chance for faster ability cooldowns. Crit also powers Bounty Hunter, so this costs Revenant damage in exchange for more Obliterate and Scar casts.
revenant.minor|Early Bloom: An extra level when you reach level 12. It gets Reckoning's next rank sooner; otherwise a generic boost.
revenant.minor|Prima Donna: You deal 10% more damage to heroes but take 6% more. A glass cannon pick that only works if your team keeps divers off you.
revenant.crest|Ortus: Move speed and physical power for 7s, and takedowns while it runs give permanent power. Pop it when chasing a fleeing target to land your crit rounds.
revenant.minor|Masterpiece: Kills grant stacking damage and move speed for a while. It helps chain kills in fights, especially with Reckoning picks.
revenant.minor|Fragrance: More magical and true damage to nearby heroes. Revenant deals physical damage, so this does almost nothing for him.
revenant.minor|Bloatware: A little more damage and damage reduction per item you own. Generic scaling with item count.
revenant.Eternal|Vesh: Ability damage on heroes leaves a small burn that grows with game time. Obliterate and Scar are your ability damage, so it only adds a little on top of a basic-attack kit.
revenant.minor|Lich: Magical lifesteal, but Revenant deals physical damage, so it heals him very little.
revenant.minor|Mind Rot: Vesh's burn also takes 2% of the target's current health. Small extra damage on Obliterate and Scar hits against full-health targets.

legion.augment|Heavy Caliber: Turns the rifle into a slow, hard-hitting long-range gun with a smaller magazine. Poke from farther away, and drop Rally Point in fights so its infinite ammo removes the reload pause.
legion.Eternal|Demiurge: Mostly a generic stat boost: every item you buy gives a bit more, and item effects hit a bit harder. Nothing specific to Legion's abilities.
legion.minor|Construct: Generic: a little more health and slightly faster ability cooldowns every level. Nothing special with Legion's kit.
legion.crest|Epoch: Your panic button. Legion has little escape, so when a diver lands on you, freeze yourself to wait out their burst, then throw Frag Order to launch yourself away or let your team collapse.
legion.augment|Press the Advantage: Every takedown drops a free Rally Point where the enemy died. It stops healing but speeds up your rifle and your team's attacks, so one kill in a teamfight snowballs into the next.
legion.Eternal|Vermis: Every third rifle shot in a row on the same hero adds damage based on their max health. Legion fires fast, so it procs often and is strongest into tanky frontliners.
legion.minor|Serration: Your Vermis shots also hit harder the more health the target is missing, so the rifle finishes wounded heroes faster late in a fight.
legion.minor|Melting Point: Bonus damage only against heavily armored targets, so it matters when the enemy tank or bruiser stacks armor. Into squishy teams it does nothing.
legion.crest|Ortus: Pop it as a fight starts for speed and extra physical power. Takedowns during it refresh the timer and add permanent power, so use it before Orbital Sanction lands on a grouped team.
legion.augment|Scorched Earth: Frag Order and every Saturation Charge mine leave burning ground, and Orbital Sanction drops fire as it chases. Great for zoning enemies off objectives and punishing teams that stand still.
legion.Eternal|Thraex: Rifle shots mark the hero you hit: you deal more to them and take less from them. Best when you lock onto one target and keep shooting instead of swapping.
legion.minor|Savage Strikes: Each rifle shot adds a little extra damage that grows while you keep hitting heroes, and heals you for it. Legion's fast rifle triggers it constantly.
legion.minor|Ferocity: Your attack speed keeps climbing every second you stay in a hero fight. Rewards long fights where Legion can keep shooting from safety.
legion.Eternal|Xyris: Bonus damage that grows as you kill minions and monsters. Saturation Charge clears waves quickly, so farming hard early ramps it up for later fights.
legion.minor|Iron Will: Rifle shots heal you a little, more on critical hits. Small sustain that pays off in long trades and crit builds.
legion.minor|Bone Collector: After you farm 150 units, your rifle gets a permanent chunk of critical chance. A farming payoff for crit builds.
legion.minor|Rallying Roar: Orbital Sanction comes back sooner, and casting it gives you and nearby allies a burst of speed to chase or reposition while the beam tracks targets.
legion.Eternal|Weald: Once a hero drops below 30% health, your next hit fires missiles that fly through walls. It finishes enemies fleeing Orbital Sanction, and more attack speed means more missiles.
legion.minor|Forage: Generic: extra gold and XP from every minion and monster kill. Nothing specific to Legion's kit.
legion.minor|Wind-Rider: Gives a short attack speed burst after a dash or leap. Legion has few of those, so it mostly triggers off a dash crest before you start shooting.
legion.crest|Pacifier: Dash in, and your next physical hit, a rifle shot or Frag Order, deals extra damage, much more against nearly dead heroes. A kill lets you recast it to chase the next one.
legion.minor|Alpha's Court: Bonus damage only while no ally hero is close by. Fits a solo lane or split-pushing, not standing with your team in fights.
legion.crest|Exodus: A grenade that knocks enemies back and makes launched heroes take more of your damage briefly. Use it to peel a diver off you, then follow with rifle shots or Frag Order.
legion.crest|Nex: Dash and burst nearby heroes for damage based on what you dealt them recently. Rifle hits store more than your area abilities, so shoot first, then dash in to cash it out.

muriel.augment|Sacrosanct: Flying in with Reversal of Fortune drops a Consecrated Ground at the ally you save, healing them and boosting their attack speed while enemies inside attack slower and take magic damage.
muriel.Eternal|Exarch: Every Alacrity shield, Reversal shield and Consecrated Ground heal makes that ally attack faster with bonus magic damage. Best when shielding your carry right as they start hitting.
muriel.minor|Illumination: Turns your bonus mana regen into health regen. A small sustain boost for lane; nothing special with the kit.
muriel.minor|Fervour: Your basic attacks on enemy heroes heal you and nearby allies. Poke with basic attacks in lane to keep your carry topped up between Alacrity shields.
muriel.crest|Tranquility: An area heal plus a short damage cut for you and nearby allies. Save it for the big burst in a fight, on top of your shields; it also gives you an extra ward.
muriel.Eternal|Knell: Your hits strip the enemy's armor and give some of it to you. Serenity and Consecrated Ground hit several enemies, so your whole team deals more damage to them.
muriel.minor|Frequency: Each armor-shred stack you keep on enemies gives you attack speed and shorter ability cooldowns. Keep landing Serenity and basic attacks to keep the stacks up.
muriel.minor|Peal: Your ultimate comes back faster, and after you land with Reversal of Fortune your hits apply full armor shred at once, so the fight you dive into turns quickly.
muriel.crest|Silentium: Silence one hero briefly so they cannot cast. Use it on the diver jumping your carry, or to stop an escape before charging a full Serenity stun. Also gives an extra ward.

drongo.augment|Bring The Boom: When Rad Rounds' stacks erupt on a target, part of that damage also hits enemies around them. Shoot the frontline during Rad Rounds to splash the group behind it.
drongo.Eternal|Weald: When you damage a hero below 30% health, true-damage missiles fly at them through walls, more with bonus attack speed. Rad Rounds' faster shots make it a strong finisher.
drongo.minor|Forage: Extra gold and XP from minions and monsters. A plain farming boost, nothing tied to the kit.
drongo.minor|Wind-Rider: Bonus attack speed for 4s after a dash or leap. Drongo has no regular dash, so it mostly triggers off a dashing crest like Pacifier.
drongo.crest|Pacifier: A short dash that empowers your next hit, much stronger on low targets, and resets on a kill. Use it to reposition and finish a target your bleed has worn down.
drongo.augment|Shred Spree: Shrapnel Cannon comes back far more often but hits much softer. It becomes a frequent armor-shred and escape tool rather than a big burst of damage.
drongo.Eternal|Xyris: Bonus damage that grows as you kill units through the game. Plain scaling for a farming carry, nothing tied to the kit.
drongo.minor|Furor: A burst of attack speed when you enter hero combat. Stacks with Rad Rounds for a fast opening flurry.
drongo.minor|Eviscerate: Extra damage against healthy targets. Helps your opening Gag Grenade and Old Rusty poke land harder at the start of a fight.
drongo.Eternal|Vermis: Every third basic attack in a row on the same hero deals a chunk of their max health. Rad Rounds' faster shots trigger it often; great into tanks.
drongo.minor|Serration: Vermis also deals extra damage based on the target's missing health, so your third hits grow stronger as the target drops.
drongo.minor|Breach: Shrapnel Cannon also strips a big chunk of physical armor for a few seconds. Fire it first, then unload your basic attacks on the shredded targets.
drongo.minor|Melting Point: Extra damage against targets with high physical armor. Good into tanks and bruisers who stack armor.
drongo.crest|Liberator: Removes crowd control and gives a short shield. Use it when you get stunned or slowed by a diver so you can keep shooting.
