drongo.Eternal|Thraex: Your basic attacks mark the target, so you deal more to them and take less back. Helps in duels against a single diver.
drongo.minor|Savage Strikes: Small extra damage and healing on each basic attack that grows while you keep hitting a hero. Fast attacks during Rad Rounds stack it quickly.
drongo.minor|Ferocity: Attack speed that keeps climbing the longer you stay in hero combat. Rewards Drongo shooting from safety through a long fight.
drongo.minor|Cull the Weak: Extra damage to minions and monsters, and mana back on kills. A plain farming boost for clearing waves.
drongo.minor|Taproot: Basic attacks heal you a little on hit. Small lane sustain for an auto-attacking carry.
drongo.minor|Dryad's Boon: No game text is available for this minor yet, so we can't say what it does for Drongo.
drongo.minor|The King: Basic attacks on enemy heroes give you gold. Rewards trading with basic attacks in lane; a plain gold boost.
drongo.minor|Alpha's Court: Extra damage when no ally is near you. A poor fit for a carry who should stand behind the team; mostly helps in solo farming or side lanes.
drongo.minor|Sub-Surface: Take less damage from area abilities. Helps survive enemy mages and area ultimates aimed at your backline.

the-fey.augment|Wild Growth: Bramble Patch can be cast further away. Easier to block an escape path or zone enemies from safety.
the-fey.Eternal|Aion: Each cast boosts your mana regen, and ability damage on heroes gives gold. Harvest Nettles is cast constantly, so you stay topped up and earn extra gold.
the-fey.minor|Bottomless Vial: Killing a river buff refills a potion and adds permanent magical power. Helps a mage who takes the river buffs.
the-fey.minor|Runic Focus: More magical power the fuller your mana bar. Harvest Nettles refunds mana on hits, so you stay near full and keep the bonus.
the-fey.crest|Soulbearer: A shield, lifesteal on your magic damage, and speed for a few seconds. Pop it when caught and keep throwing Harvest Nettles to heal.
the-fey.Eternal|Vesh: Every ability that hits a hero adds a burn on top. Harvest Nettles has a short cooldown, so the burn stays up all fight.
the-fey.minor|Tithe of Death: Takedowns restore mana and permanently shorten your cooldowns up to a cap. Fly Trap fights that net kills make you cast faster for the rest of the game.
the-fey.minor|Mind Rot: Your Vesh burn also deals damage based on the target's current health, so your spells hurt healthy, tanky heroes more.
the-fey.crest|Epoch: Your panic button. When divers jump you, freeze yourself to wait out their burst until your team helps.
the-fey.augment|Natural Infusion: Every Harvest Nettles hit on a hero stacks faster cooldowns for a few seconds, with no cap. Keep hitting heroes to throw Nettles and Untamed Growth nonstop.
the-fey.minor|Perfection: Much faster cooldowns while you are near full health. Stay out of reach and poke with Harvest Nettles to keep it on.
the-fey.augment|Verdant Embrace: Untamed Growth also heals you and allies standing in it, again when it explodes. Drop it at your team's feet in fights; your takedown plants heal too.
the-fey.crest|Winter's Fury: An expanding zone that slows and makes enemies take more magic damage. Cast it before Untamed Growth, Harvest Nettles and Fly Trap so they hit harder.

gideon.augment|Infinite Impact: Void Breach flies across the map, so you can snipe low targets or poke from very far away. Great for finishing fleeing enemies.
gideon.Eternal|Vesh: Every ability hit leaves a short burn. Void Breach, Cosmic Rift and Black Hole all add extra damage after they land.
gideon.minor|Tithe of Death: Takedowns refund mana and permanently shorten your ability cooldowns, up to a cap. Snowballs Gideon's spell rotation as the fights go your way.
gideon.minor|Phylactery: After Black Hole, your cooldowns tick twice as fast for 4s and you get a shield based on your max mana, so Void Breach and Cosmic Rift come back sooner.
gideon.crest|Epoch: Freeze yourself in place, safe from damage. Use it if you get dived while channeling or after Black Hole lets you act, then teleport away with Torn Space.
gideon.Eternal|Demiurge: Makes all your item stats and item effects stronger. Generic power boost; nothing special with the kit.
gideon.minor|Construct: Extra health and ability cooldown reduction every level. Generic stats; nothing special with the kit.
gideon.minor|Memory Leak: Every ability cast permanently adds max mana, which also speeds up Void Breach's cooldown. Eventually it gives you movement speed too.
gideon.crest|Soulbearer: A shield plus magic healing and movement speed. Pop it before a fight to survive the dive and heal off your Cosmic Rift and Black Hole damage.
gideon.augment|Event Horizon: Cosmic Rift deals extra damage based on the target's max health in the center. Aim the middle on tanks, or on enemies caught in Black Hole.
gideon.minor|Millennia: Your ultimate's damage slowly grows over the game. A small late-game boost to Black Hole; nothing else changes.
gideon.minor|The Tenth Seal: From level 10, Black Hole hits harder and comes back sooner, so you get it more often in team fights.
gideon.minor|Mind Rot: Vesh's burn also chips part of the target's current health, so it hits hardest when you open on healthy, beefy targets.
gideon.Eternal|Aion: Every spell cast boosts mana regen and your ability damage on heroes earns gold. Gideon casts a lot, so it fuels both his mana and items.
gideon.minor|Bottomless Vial: Taking a river buff refills a potion and permanently adds magic power. Generic sustain and power; nothing special with the kit.
gideon.minor|Arcane Resonance: With Aion's mana regen stacked from casting, your basic ability cooldowns tick faster, so Void Breach and Cosmic Rift come back sooner.
gideon.minor|Lich: Your magic damage heals you, growing as you level. Black Hole and Cosmic Rift hitting several enemies make it heal a lot in team fights.
gideon.crest|Typhoon: Your basic attacks build attack speed and eventually a short dash. Gideon fights with abilities, so this does little for his kit.
gideon.augment|Abyssal Mantle: Starting Black Hole gives you a shield, helping you survive the channel while divers try to interrupt you.
gideon.minor|Runic Focus: More magic power while your mana is high. Gideon's mana pool is big, so open fights at full mana for your strongest Cosmic Rift and Black Hole.
gideon.minor|Perfection: Shorter ability cooldowns while you stay near full health. Rewards poking safely from range with Void Breach and Cosmic Rift.
gideon.crest|Wizard Crest: Ability hits and kills refund mana, and after enough it can be upgraded at base. A generic mana starter; nothing special with the kit.

crunch.augment|Combo Crunch: Each empowered punch after an ability stacks attack speed. Weave ability, punch, ability, punch to keep the stacks up and land more hits between casts.
crunch.Eternal|Lotus: Generic: every 2 minutes and every takedown you get a random small boost to damage, cooldowns, speed or health. Nothing specific to Crunch's kit.
crunch.minor|Masterpiece: Each kill gives stacking bonus damage and movement speed for a short time. Helps Crunch roll from one target to the next in a teamfight.
crunch.minor|Fragrance: Boosts magic and especially true damage against close heroes. Crunch's empowered punch deals magic damage and his Turbo Left Crunch deals true damage, so his fighting range fits it.
crunch.crest|Eviscerator: Pop it when you commit: 20% faster attacks, healing from all your damage and stronger basic attacks for 6s. More punches land between Crunch's ability casts.
crunch.augment|Lunge Crunch: Forward Crunch dashes farther, so you can start fights or catch fleeing targets from longer range, and get out further when you need to.
crunch.Eternal|Vesh: Every ability that hits a hero adds a short burn on top. Crunch casts constantly, so the burn stays up through a whole brawl.
crunch.minor|The Tenth Seal: From level 10, Re-Crunch comes back much faster, so you can repeat your best ability, like the knock-up or true-damage swing, more often in fights.
crunch.minor|Millennia: A slow, small ramp to ultimate damage over the game. Crunch's ultimate mostly repeats other abilities, so this is a minor pick.
crunch.crest|Typhoon: Basic attacks stack attack speed, and full stacks give a short dash. Lets Crunch stick to targets between ability casts.
crunch.Eternal|Thraex: Your punches mark the hero you hit: more damage to them, less damage from them. Good for one-on-one fights where Crunch stays on a single target.
crunch.minor|Alpha's Court: Bonus damage only when no ally hero is nearby. Pays off on solo ganks or dueling alone, not in grouped fights.
crunch.minor|Ferocity: Attack speed keeps climbing for every second you stay in a hero fight. Rewards long brawls where Crunch keeps punching between abilities.
crunch.crest|Iceskorn Talons: Drop an ice sheet where you dive in: allies on it gain power and speed, enemies on it are slowed. Use it when your team follows you into a fight.
crunch.minor|Lich: Heals you from magic damage. Crunch's empowered punch after each ability deals magic damage, so it gives a little sustain in fights.
crunch.minor|Phylactery: After you cast Re-Crunch, your other cooldowns tick down much faster for a moment and you get a shield. Cast ultimate mid-fight to chain into a second full combo.
crunch.Eternal|Pilow: Every ability you cast weakens the damage of nearby enemy heroes, stacking up to 3 times. Crunch casts nonstop in melee range, so he keeps it stacked.
crunch.minor|Bioluminescence: Enemies you damage take 3% more damage and are revealed for 4s, so they can't slip away from you in bushes.
crunch.minor|Neurotoxin: Your Pilow stacks also make enemies take more damage, so Crunch's ability spam both weakens them and softens them up for your team.
crunch.crest|Judgement: An area blast around you that heals per hero hit. Use it in the middle of a brawl when several enemies are around you.
crunch.Eternal|Demiurge: Mostly a generic stat boost: every item you buy gives a bit more, and item effects hit harder. Nothing specific to Crunch's kit.
crunch.minor|Bio-Mechanical Fusion: Turns magical power into physical power. Only does anything if your items give magical power; otherwise it is empty.
crunch.minor|Cursed Corrupted: Turns critical chance into faster ability cooldowns. Only useful if your items give crit, since Crunch fights with abilities rather than crits.
crunch.crest|Brutallax: Cleanses slows and stuns and makes you hard to lock down for a moment; keep punching to extend it. Use it to dive through the enemy's crowd control.
crunch.minor|Harmonic Currents: Every ability cast restores some missing health and mana. Crunch casts nonstop, so it is steady sustain through a fight.
crunch.Eternal|Krix: Generic tankiness: more max health, and you grow a little bigger. Nothing specific to Crunch's kit.
crunch.minor|Regenerative Tissue: Heals you over time after a few seconds away from hero damage. Generic sustain between fights.
crunch.minor|Cannibalism: Each takedown adds permanent max health. Generic tankiness that grows if you get kills.
crunch.Eternal|Vermis: Every third basic attack in a row on the same hero adds damage based on their max health. Weave punches between abilities on one target, strongest into tanks.
crunch.minor|Crush: Locking a hero down deals a chunk of their max health. Forward Crunch's stun and Turbo Right Crunch's knock-up both trigger it.
crunch.minor|Breach: Your ultimate damage cuts the target's armor briefly. Crunch's ultimate repeats another ability, and our data does not confirm that hit counts as ultimate damage, so treat this as uncertain.
crunch.minor|Tri-Core: Basic attacks deal a little extra damage of a random type. Small bonus on the punches between Crunch's abilities.
crunch.minor|Memory Leak: Each ability cast slowly grows your max mana, and eventually gives a bit of movement speed. Helps Crunch keep casting without running dry.
crunch.minor|Mind Rot: Your Vesh burn also deals damage based on the target's current health, so ability hits on healthy, tanky heroes hurt more.
crunch.crest|Gravitum: Fires a long-range shot that stops the first hero hit from dashing or jumping. Use it before Forward Crunch so the target cannot escape your combo.
crunch.Eternal|Nihil: Hitting a hero gives Crunch Doom for 3s, adding power and armor for every 3s Doom lasts, so steady basic attacks and abilities on heroes keep Doom going; level-ups and takedowns raise the gains 20% for good.
crunch.minor|From the Abyss: Crunch regains a share of max health each second in hero fights or out of enemy vision, more at levels 6, 11 and 16. Re-Crunch's passive heal on every third hit adds to this in long brawls.
crunch.minor|Terror: Crunch takes 35% less damage from minions and monsters and 25% less from towers. Nothing special with the kit: camp clears and tower dives simply cost Crunch less health.

grim-exe.augment|System Restore: Blocking an ability with Energy Shield now also heals you and gives a burst of move speed. Time the shield on a key skillshot, then reposition.
grim-exe.Eternal|Xyris: Bonus damage that grows as you kill units. A plain damage boost that rewards farming; nothing special with his kit.
grim-exe.minor|Iron Will: Basic attacks heal a little, doubled on critical strikes. Assault Mode attacks can crit, so it sustains you while sieging from range.
grim-exe.minor|Bone Collector: After enough kills you permanently gain 20% crit chance. Assault Mode's bonus damage can crit, so it boosts your long-range attacks.
grim-exe.crest|Eviscerator: Attack faster, heal from all damage, and add damage to each attack for 6s. Pop it during an Assault Mode fight to shred with fast cleaving attacks.
grim-exe.augment|Instant Reload: GTFO executes heroes that fall below 5% health and can then be cast again for 8s. Aim the first shot on a low target to chain into a second.
grim-exe.Eternal|Knell: Attacks and abilities stack Rust on heroes, cutting their armor and adding some to yours. Grim attacks constantly, so stacks build fast in any trade.
grim-exe.minor|Frequency: Attack speed and ability cooldown speed for each Rust stack on targets. Rewards keeping Knell stacked with steady attacks.
grim-exe.minor|Fracture: Extra damage against targets at max Rust. With his fast attacks, Grim keeps targets at max stacks easily.
grim-exe.crest|Sharpshooter Crest: Basic attacks and kills slowly heal you, and once enough healing is done it evolves at base into a stronger crest. A patient lane crest for a basic-attack carry.
grim-exe.minor|Furor: Entering hero combat gives a burst of attack speed for 4s. Your opening attacks in a trade come out faster.
grim-exe.minor|Cull the Weak: Bonus damage to minions and monsters plus a little mana back per kill. Helps Assault Mode's mana-costing attacks while clearing waves.
grim-exe.crest|Liberator: Removes every debuff and gives you a shield. Use it to break crowd control when divers reach you.
grim-exe.Eternal|Weald: Hitting a hero below 30% health fires true-damage missiles that pass through walls, with more missiles from bonus attack speed. Helps finish fleeing targets.
grim-exe.minor|Forage: Plain extra gold and XP from minions and monsters; a farming boost with nothing special for his kit.
grim-exe.minor|Taproot: Basic attacks heal a little, scaling with bonus physical power. Small sustain while you attack constantly.
grim-exe.crest|Pacifier: A short dash that empowers your next physical hit, much stronger below 20% health. Grim's attacks deal magical damage, so its main use here is the dash.
grim-exe.Eternal|Vermis: Every third basic attack in a row on the same hero deals a chunk of their max health. Fits Grim's steady attacking and hurts tanks.
grim-exe.minor|Serration: Vermis also takes some of the target's missing health, making your third hit a stronger finisher.
grim-exe.minor|Melting Point: Bonus damage against targets with high physical armor. Take it when the enemy front line is armor-heavy.

terra.augment|Axe Retrieval: Highland Hurl hits harder and can be picked back up to cut its cooldown. Throw it, walk over it, and slow or root enemies again much sooner.
terra.Eternal|Idrisil: Extra armor while healthy, then dropping low trades it for a shield based on your armor. Terra stacks armor from her ult, so the shield is large.
terra.minor|Cold Hearted: Enemies who basic attack you slow down. Makes it harder for attackers to kite away from Terra.
terra.minor|Icy Touch: Your basic attacks lower the enemy's attack speed. Helps Terra win duels against attack-based heroes.
terra.crest|Razorback: More armor and reflected damage for 5s. Pop it when the enemy team focuses Terra, especially during Unstoppable Force.
terra.augment|Iron Resolve: Take much less damage while charging Wild Rush. You can safely hold the charge for full range and damage before dashing in.
terra.Eternal|Krix: More max health and bigger size. A plain tankiness boost for Terra's frontline role.
terra.minor|Voracity: Unit kills heal a little and give extra gold. Light sustain for laning and jungling.
terra.minor|Cannibalism: Takedowns permanently add max health. Generic scaling that rewards fighting.
terra.crest|Nyr Warboots: A burst of speed and fast healing for 5s. Use it to reach the fight, or to walk out after Unstoppable Force ends.
terra.minor|Mending: After taking hero damage, slowly restores missing health. Fits Terra's job of soaking damage up front.
terra.crest|Saphir's Mantle: Grow bigger and tankier while damaging nearby heroes, then keep some max health permanently. Pop it in the middle of a brawl.
terra.minor|Diamond Tip: More armor penetration per finished item. Makes Terra's abilities hit harder against tanky targets late game.
terra.augment|Hersir's Will: During Unstoppable Force you keep gaining Hersir stacks, so nearly every basic ability you cast during the ult is empowered.
terra.minor|Frost Snap: More damage to slowed or rooted enemies. Highland Hurl and her ult both slow, so this is easy to keep active.
terra.minor|Glacier: Generic: magical armor that slowly builds with the gold you earn.

wraith.augment|Sniper's Bounty: Killing blows with Knock, Knock! give extra gold, a lot more on heroes. Use the sniper shot to last-hit minions and finish fleeing heroes from range.
wraith.Eternal|Weald: Damaging a hero below 30% health fires missiles that pass through walls. Pairs with a long-range Knock, Knock! hit to finish someone running away.
wraith.minor|Forage: Plain economy: a bit more gold and XP from each minion or monster kill.
wraith.minor|Wind-Rider: Gives attack speed for 4s after a dash, leap, teleport or leaving stealth. Surprise, Surprise! gives Camouflage, which the text does not list, so Wraith has few sure triggers for it.
wraith.crest|Ortus: A burst of speed and physical power, and takedowns during it grant permanent power. Pop it before a pick so your snipe and follow-up hit harder.
wraith.Eternal|Demiurge: Boosts the stats your items give and their damage effects. A generic build-amplifier with no special Wraith link.
wraith.minor|Tri-Core: Basic attacks deal a bit of extra damage of a random type. A small on-hit boost for Wraith's slower, heavy shots.
wraith.minor|Memory Leak: Each ability cast permanently adds max mana. Spamming Knock, Knock! on minions builds it fast, helping a mana-hungry poke style.
wraith.Eternal|Vesh: Ability damage to heroes also adds a short damage-over-time. Knock, Knock! and Peekaboo! hits keep burning after they land, adding to long-range poke.
wraith.minor|Lich: Magical lifesteal that grows with level. Only useful if Wraith deals magic damage, such as with Mystic Marksman or the Peekaboo! mark bonus.
wraith.minor|Mind Rot: The Vesh burn also deals damage based on the target's current health. Best for opening snipes on enemies who are still healthy.
wraith.crest|Epoch: Freeze yourself in stasis for 2.5s. Use it to dodge a dive on you after you've been caught.
wraith.Eternal|Satariel: Takedowns stack big power and attack speed, but lower your max health and you lose stacks on death. Strong for a Wraith who can keep sniping safely from range.
wraith.minor|Demonic Bargain: Generic: extra gold at levels 1 and 10.
wraith.minor|Broken Wings: Your speed cannot be changed by items or abilities, so slows can't touch you, but Surprise, Surprise!'s speed boost won't help either.
wraith.crest|Witchstalker: Cleanses debuffs and empowers your next hit with damage based on the target's max health, healing you for it. Good for a heavy opening snipe on a tank.
wraith.augment|Mystic Marksman: Knock, Knock! deals magic damage instead of physical. Builds Wraith around magical power, where the sniper shot ignores physical armor stacks.
wraith.minor|Construct: Generic: a little health and ability cooldown speed every level.
wraith.minor|Bloatware: A bit more damage and damage reduction per item owned. A generic late-game stat pick.
wraith.Eternal|Lotus: Random small boosts every few minutes and on takedowns: damage, ability cooldowns, speed or health. A generic scaling pick.
wraith.minor|Early Bloom: Generic: an extra level when you hit level 12.
wraith.minor|Prima Donna: More damage to heroes, more damage taken. Fits a Wraith who stays far back sniping; punishing if he gets caught.
wraith.Eternal|Thraex: The last hero you hit with a basic attack is marked: you deal more to them and take less from them. Keep basic attacking the same target to hold the mark.
wraith.minor|Alpha's Court: Bonus damage when no ally is nearby. Helps when sniping or pushing alone, not when grouped.
wraith.minor|Ferocity: Attack speed keeps building the longer you stay in a hero fight. Rewards Wraith staying in long basic-attack fights.
wraith.crest|Typhoon: Basic attacks stack attack speed, and at full stacks you dash. Gives Wraith a repositioning dash during sustained fights.
wraith.minor|Tithe of Death: Takedowns restore mana and permanently lower ability cooldowns up to a cap. Means more Knock, Knock! casts as the game goes on.
wraith.crest|Pacifier: A short dash that empowers your next physical hit, much stronger on targets below 20% health. Dash, then finish a low target with a basic attack or snipe.

aurora.augment|Hypothermia: Boreal Sweep hits shred armor and magic armor and slow the enemy's attacks. Open with it so the rest of your combo and your team's damage land harder.
aurora.Eternal|Vesh: Every ability that hits a hero adds a short burn. Boreal Sweep, Hoarfrost and Cryoseism all deal magic damage, so the burn stacks up through your combo.
aurora.minor|Lich: Heals you from magic damage. Aurora's abilities and the magic part of her basic attack all count, so it gives steady sustain in fights.
aurora.minor|Mind Rot: Your Vesh burn also deals damage based on the target's current health, so your ability combo hurts healthy, tanky heroes more.
aurora.crest|Tempest: Damages up to 3 nearby heroes every second and heals you. Pop it when you dive in with Glacial Charge and stay in the middle of the fight.
aurora.augment|Glacial Thorns: Glacial Charge leaves crystals at its start that damage and briefly root. Dash past enemies so they are stuck right where you started, then follow with Hoarfrost.
aurora.Eternal|Krix: Generic tankiness: more max health and slightly bigger size. Nothing specific to Aurora's kit.
aurora.minor|Voracity: Generic: unit kills restore a little health and give a bit of gold. Helps sustain while farming camps.
aurora.minor|Predator: Killing a camp's leader gives bonus damage and speed for a while, longer after epic monsters. Clear a camp right before you gank.
aurora.crest|Typhoon: Basic attacks stack attack speed, and full stacks give a short dash. Fits an attack-speed Aurora who keeps her Frost Storm going with fast hits.
aurora.minor|Feeding Frenzy: More attack speed for each enemy hero nearby. Helps Aurora keep her Frost Storm active when she dives into a group.
aurora.crest|Winter's Fury: An expanding ice zone that slows and makes enemies take more magic damage. Cast it before Boreal Sweep, Hoarfrost and Cryoseism so they all land harder.
aurora.augment|Frozen Fury: Your Frost Storm also gives attack speed while it is up. Hit enemies quickly to keep the storm refreshed and your attacks fast.
aurora.minor|The Tenth Seal: From level 10, Cryoseism gets 5% more damage and 25 ultimate haste, so her area slow-then-stun is ready for more fights.
aurora.minor|Millennia: A slow, small ramp to Cryoseism's damage over the game. Minor value.
aurora.Eternal|Idrisil: Extra armor while healthy, and dropping low turns it into a shield. Keeps Aurora alive after she dives with Glacial Charge.
aurora.minor|Frost Snap: Bonus damage to slowed or rooted targets. Aurora slows with Boreal Sweep and Cryoseism and roots with Hoarfrost, so it is almost always on.
aurora.minor|Diamond Tip: Generic: more armor penetration for each finished item. Nothing specific to Aurora's kit.
aurora.minor|Regenerative Tissue: Heals you over time after a few seconds away from hero damage. Generic sustain between fights.
aurora.minor|Festering Wounds: Your roots, stuns and burns cut the enemy's healing. Hoarfrost and Cryoseism apply it, so use it into healing-heavy teams.
aurora.minor|Glacier: Generic: permanent magic armor as you earn gold. Nothing specific to Aurora's kit.
aurora.crest|Leafsong: A support crest: gives nearby allies speed, immunity to slows and lets them pass through heroes. Use it to start or escape a fight with your team; it also adds an extra ward.

adele.augment|Seeds of Dominion: Imperial Lash drops a Thornbush under the target she dashes to, slowing and hurting enemies who move in it, and Imperial Lash comes back sooner. More engage pressure.
adele.Eternal|Krix: Plain bonus maximum health that grows each level. Generic tankiness for a frontline Adele, nothing special with her abilities.
adele.minor|Regenerative Tissue: After a while without taking hero damage, Adele slowly regenerates health. Helps recover between lane trades without going back to base.
adele.minor|Cannibalism: Each takedown permanently adds a little maximum health. Generic tankiness that grows if Adele gets kills and assists.
adele.crest|Razorback: Activate when enemies dive her for extra armor and to reflect part of their damage back. Pair it with Iron Rose to soak a burst while her vines keep ticking.
adele.augment|Tyrant of Thorns: Adele herself now gets her Thorns bonus true damage at 400% strength on marked enemies. Royal Flourish returns faster with more speed but no longer Mesmerizes. Trades crowd control for her own damage.
adele.Eternal|Thraex: Basic attacks mark her target: she deals more damage to them and takes less from them. Good for dueling one enemy while Iron Rose's vine ticks.
adele.minor|Alpha's Court: Adele deals bonus damage when no ally is close by. Rewards solo dueling in a side lane or catching enemies alone.
adele.minor|Ferocity: Attack speed keeps rising each second she stays in a hero fight. Her basic attacks add true damage, so long duels favor her more as they go.
adele.crest|Saphir's Mantle: Activate to grow bigger, gain max health and damage nearby heroes, then keep some max health permanently. Use it after Imperial Lash pulls her into enemies.
adele.minor|Predator: Killing camp leaders gives her bonus damage and speed for a while, longer after epic monsters. Rewards a jungle Adele who clears a camp right before ganking.
adele.crest|Nyr Warboots: Activate for a burst of speed and steady healing. Use it to chase after Imperial Lash, or to escape and recover after a trade.
adele.augment|Court of Roses: Iron Rose also gives the nearest ally a damage-reducing barrier and attaches weaker vines to nearby enemy heroes. Turns her defensive cast into protection for a teammate.
adele.crest|Sanctification: Shields Adele and nearby allies and makes them harder to stun or slow while it holds. Pop it as a fight starts. Support crest with an extra ward slot.
adele.minor|Voracity: Small health and gold refund on each minion or monster kill. Generic lane sustain, nothing tied to Adele's abilities.
adele.Eternal|Idrisil: Extra armor while healthy, then a shield when she drops below 30% health. Stacks with Iron Rose's damage reduction to survive dives.
adele.minor|Cold Hearted: Enemies who basic attack her get slightly slowed, stacking. Helps against attack-based carries chasing her; nothing tied to her abilities.
adele.minor|Icy Touch: Her basic attacks lower the target's attack speed, stacking. Weakens attack-based duelists in long trades.
adele.crest|Leafsong: Speeds up nearby allies and makes them immune to slows for a few seconds. Use it to engage together or escape. Support crest with an extra ward slot.

sevarog.augment|Unholy Pursuit: Phantom Rush earns souls when it hits heroes, and it comes back instantly when Colossal Blow lands on a hero. Blow an enemy away, then Rush after them to fear them again.
sevarog.Eternal|Krix: More max health and a bigger body. Plain tankiness that stacks with the health Sevarog's souls already give him.
sevarog.minor|Voracity: Killing any unit heals you a bit and gives a little gold. Small sustain while farming waves and souls with Siphon.
sevarog.minor|Cannibalism: Each takedown adds permanent max health. Plain tankiness on top of your soul stacks.
sevarog.crest|Saphir's Mantle: Grow and gain max health for a few seconds while damaging heroes near you, then keep some health permanently. Pop it before you Phantom Rush into the enemy team.
sevarog.augment|Grim Harvest: Siphon kills any enemy that drops very low. Siphon is your fastest ability, so it doubles as a finisher and secures more souls.
sevarog.crest|Razorback: Short burst of armor plus reflected damage back at heroes hitting you. Use it when the enemy turns to focus you after Subjugate.
sevarog.minor|Regenerative Tissue: Heal a share of max health after a few seconds away from hero damage. Big max health from souls makes each tick worth more between fights.

yin.augment|Storm of Salvation: Windburn lasts a bit longer and your hits heal you based on missing health while it is active. Turn it on when the fight gets close to sustain through long trades.
yin.Eternal|Weald: When you damage a hero below 30% health, true-damage missiles fly at them through walls, more with bonus attack speed. Rising Storm's attack speed makes it a strong finisher.
yin.minor|Forage: Extra gold and XP from minions and monsters. A plain farming boost, nothing tied to the kit.
yin.minor|Taproot: Basic attacks heal you a little on hit. Yin attacks fast once Rising Storm stacks, so it adds steady small sustain.
yin.crest|Liberator: Removes crowd control and gives a short shield. Use it when stunned or slowed so you can keep attacking and hold your Rising Storm stacks.
yin.minor|Wind-Rider: Lash Kick pulls and leaps, so you get bonus attack speed right after it. Your first hits on the target come in faster.
yin.Eternal|Vermis: Every third basic attack in a row on the same hero deals a chunk of their max health. It stacks with Windburn's own third-hit bonus for big damage into tanks.
yin.minor|Serration: Vermis also deals extra damage based on the target's missing health, so your third hits grow stronger as the target drops.
yin.minor|Melting Point: Extra damage against targets with high physical armor. Good into tanks and bruisers who stack armor.
yin.crest|Pacifier: A short dash that empowers your next hit, much stronger on low targets, and resets on a kill. Use it to finish a target after Lash Kick is spent.
yin.Eternal|Thraex: Your basic attacks mark the target, so you deal more to them and take less back. Helps in long duels where you keep hitting one hero.
yin.minor|Alpha's Court: Extra damage when no ally is near you. Fits a solo-lane duelist, but turns off in grouped fights.
yin.minor|Ferocity: Attack speed that keeps climbing the longer you stay in hero combat. Stacks with Rising Storm in long fights.
yin.minor|Savage Strikes: Small extra damage and healing on each basic attack that grows while you keep hitting a hero. Fast attacks from Rising Storm stack it quickly.

feng-mao.augment|Seismic Smash: Earth Shatter also knocks up and stuns, so it locks enemies in place even when it does not execute. Land it on a group to start or finish a fight.
feng-mao.Eternal|Lotus: A random small stat bonus every couple of minutes and on every takedown. Nothing specific to Feng Mao's kit; it grows slowly if you get takedowns.
feng-mao.minor|Early Bloom: One extra level at level 12, so your ability ranks come a little earlier. A generic power bump.
feng-mao.minor|Prima Donna: More damage to heroes but you take more from everything. Risky on a melee fighter who dives with Reaping Dash.
feng-mao.crest|Witchstalker: Removes crowd control and empowers your next hit with damage based on the target's max health that also heals you. Use it after being slowed, then hit with Hamstring.
feng-mao.augment|Imperial Duelist: Your basic attacks debuff the target for 3s, so you deal 5% more and take 5% less against them. Strong in one-on-one duels, where Hamstring also hits harder on a single target.
feng-mao.minor|Masterpiece: Each kill gives a short stacking boost to damage and move speed. Pairs with Reaping Dash, whose cooldown drops by 80% on takedowns, to chain into the next target.
feng-mao.crest|Nex: A short dash that hits nearby heroes, stronger after you have been dealing damage. Use it to stay on a target after Reaping Dash is spent.
feng-mao.Eternal|Pilow: Every ability you cast weakens nearby enemy heroes' damage for a few seconds, stacking. Cycling Hamstring and Safeguard keeps it up in close fights.
feng-mao.minor|Diffusion: Makes Pilow's weakening pulse reach farther and last longer. Easier to keep the debuff on several enemies.
feng-mao.minor|Convection: You gain armor for every Pilow debuff stack on nearby enemies. Keep casting abilities near them to tank more.
feng-mao.crest|Ortus: Burst of move speed and physical power for a few seconds, with permanent power on takedowns. Use it to close in before Reaping Dash.
feng-mao.Eternal|Vesh: Your ability damage on heroes leaves a burn afterward. Hamstring's two hits and Earth Shatter each add their own burn.
feng-mao.minor|Lich: Your magical damage heals you. Feng Mao deals physical damage, so this does almost nothing for him.
feng-mao.minor|Phylactery: After Earth Shatter, your cooldowns run much faster for a few seconds and you get a mana-based shield. Follow your ultimate with fast Hamstrings.
feng-mao.augment|Ichorous Glaive: Kills restore part of your missing health, a big chunk for Earth Shatter executions. Rewards using Earth Shatter to finish low targets.
feng-mao.Eternal|Demiurge: Your items give more stats and their effects hit harder. A generic scaling boost, nothing tied to the kit.
feng-mao.minor|Construct: Health and ability cooldown reduction every level. A plain stat boost, nothing special with the kit.
feng-mao.minor|Bloatware: A little more damage and damage reduction for every item you own. Generic late-game scaling.
feng-mao.minor|Flawless: Ability hits on heroes heal you and nearby allies a little, once per cast. Hamstring and Reaping Dash trigger it often; it scales with magical power Feng Mao rarely builds.

bayle.augment|Frenzied Fighter: Once Bayle drops low, Berserk stays on with no cooldown, so its attack speed, move speed and crowd control resistance never run out. Built for brawling at low health instead of backing off.
bayle.Eternal|Marrow: Heals Bayle off damage dealt to heroes, more the lower he is. Pairs with Dire Howl's healing and Berserk, so his low-health brawling keeps him alive longer.
bayle.minor|Blood Bank: Big hits like Skull Crusher, Cursed Edge and Kingslayer store up charges that briefly add lifesteal, so his follow-up swings heal more right after a combo.
bayle.minor|Jealousy: Bayle hits harder the lower his health gets, stacking with Berserk kicking in at low health. Rewards staying in the fight while hurt.
bayle.crest|Eviscerator: Activate to swing faster, heal off damage and add damage to basic attacks for a few seconds. Best right after Skull Crusher lowers the target's armor.
bayle.augment|Swift Strikes: Every ability cast speeds up Bayle's next swing, and his attack chain opens on the heavy third hit, at reduced damage. Weave a basic attack after each ability for quick bursts.
bayle.Eternal|Thraex: Basic attacks mark his target: he deals more damage to them and takes less from them. Lock onto the enemy Skull Crusher hit and keep swinging.
bayle.minor|Savage Strikes: Adds a bit of damage to each basic attack that grows while he keeps hitting a hero, and heals for it. Strong with Berserk's attack speed in long trades.
bayle.minor|Ferocity: Attack speed keeps rising each second Bayle stays in a hero fight, so long fights favor Bayle more as they go. Weak in quick skirmishes.
bayle.crest|Judgement: Activate mid-fight to hit everyone around him and heal on each hero hit; the first heals fully, the rest at 50%. Use after Skull Crusher lands him in the crowd.
bayle.Eternal|Krix: Plain bonus maximum health that grows each level, making Bayle tankier when he dives with Skull Crusher. Nothing special with his kit beyond that.
bayle.minor|Voracity: Small health and gold refund on each minion or monster kill. Generic lane sustain, nothing tied to Bayle's abilities.
bayle.minor|Cannibalism: Each takedown permanently adds a little maximum health. Generic tankiness that grows if Bayle gets kills and assists.
bayle.augment|Betrayer's Reqiuem: Kingslayer now launches every enemy near the first hero hit, not just one, and comes back sooner. Aim it into a grouped team for a group knock-up instead of a single pick.
bayle.minor|Alpha's Court: Bayle deals bonus damage when no ally is close by. Rewards solo dueling in a side lane or catching enemies alone.
bayle.Eternal|Idrisil: Extra armor while healthy, then a shield when he drops below 30% health. Berserk starts a bit earlier at 35%, so the shield buys time during his low-health attack speed burst.
bayle.minor|Mending: After taking hero damage, Bayle heals back some missing health over a few seconds. Good for soaking pokes in lane and recovering after a trade.
bayle.minor|Glacier: Generic magic armor that grows with gold earned. Helps against mage damage; nothing tied to Bayle's abilities.
bayle.crest|Nyr Warboots: Activate for a burst of speed and steady healing. Use it to chase after Skull Crusher, or to escape and recover once Berserk runs out.
bayle.Eternal|Nihil: Damaging heroes builds bonus power and armor the longer the fight lasts, and grows permanently on level-ups and takedowns. Suits Bayle staying in long brawls.
bayle.minor|From the Abyss: Heals a share of max health every second while fighting heroes or out of enemy sight. Keeps Bayle in long fights longer.
bayle.minor|Adaptive Plating: Taking hits stacks extra armor of the matching type, so Bayle gets tougher the longer a fight goes on.
bayle.Eternal|Xyris: Bonus damage that grows as he kills minions and monsters. Generic farming scaling; Cursed Edge's piercing slashes help clear waves to stack it.
bayle.minor|Dominance: Every takedown heals Bayle, more when low on health. Lets Bayle keep fighting after a kill instead of backing off.
bayle.minor|Bone Collector: After enough minion and monster kills, Bayle permanently gains critical chance. A farming reward that makes basic attacks spike later.
bayle.Eternal|Weald: Hitting a hero below 30% health fires true-damage missiles that pass through walls, more with bonus attack speed. Helps finish enemies fleeing Kingslayer or a Berserk chase.
bayle.minor|Dryad's Boon: There's no game text for this minor in our data, so we can't say what it does for Bayle.
bayle.minor|Taproot: Basic attacks heal a small amount, more with bonus physical power. Simple steady sustain for lane trades.
bayle.crest|Iceskorn Talons: Drops an ice field around Bayle that powers up and speeds allies on it and slows enemies. Use it as he dives with Skull Crusher so the team can follow.
bayle.Eternal|Knell: Each Bayle basic attack or ability on an enemy hero adds a Rust stack for 5s, cutting that hero's physical and magical armor; Bayle gains 75% of the armor cut. Vigil swings plus abilities reach the 4-stack cap fast.
bayle.minor|Frequency: Each Rust stack Bayle currently has applied through Knell gives Bayle 2% attack speed and 2 ability haste, which shortens ability cooldowns. Keeping Vigil swings and abilities landing on heroes keeps the bonus up.
bayle.minor|Resonant Repair: Whenever Bayle is immobilized, Bayle restores 3% of max health over 4s and gains 20 tenacity for 4s, which shortens crowd control landing in that window. Generic survival; nothing special with Bayle's kit.

riktor.augment|Wanton Warden: Heals back part of the damage you take over a few seconds. Riktor wants to soak damage after pulling a target with Riplash, so this keeps him standing in long fights.
riktor.Eternal|Krix: Generic tankiness: more max health and a slightly bigger body. Nothing specific to Riktor's abilities, but it helps him survive as the frontliner holding targets with Riplash and Skewer.
riktor.minor|Regenerative Tissue: Heals you over time after a few seconds away from hero damage. Generic sustain while roaming between fights.
riktor.minor|Cannibalism: Each takedown adds permanent max health. Generic tankiness that grows as your team gets kills.
riktor.crest|Leafsong: Gives nearby allies speed, immunity to slows and lets them pass through heroes. Use it to rush your team onto a target you just hooked, or to escape; it also adds a ward.
riktor.augment|Zap O' 9-Chains: After every ability, your next basic attack within 3s zaps up to 9 nearby enemies. Weave a whip attack after Riplash, Shock Therapy or Electrocute to add damage across the whole fight.
riktor.minor|Festering Wounds: Riplash's pull and Skewer's hold cut the enemy's healing for a few seconds. Take it into teams that heal a lot.
riktor.crest|Nyr Warboots: A burst of decaying speed plus healing over a few seconds. Use it to walk in for a hook, or to get away healthier after you soak damage.
riktor.crest|Sanctification: Shields you and nearby allies and makes them harder to lock down while it holds. Pop it as the enemy throws their crowd control in a teamfight.
riktor.Eternal|Pilow: Every ability you cast weakens nearby enemy heroes' damage, stacking up to 3 times. Riktor fights up close with several abilities, so he keeps it stacked on their divers.
riktor.minor|Bioluminescence: Enemies you hit take a bit more damage from everyone and are revealed. Your hook target can't escape into bushes.
riktor.minor|Neurotoxin: Your Pilow stacks also make enemies take more damage, so your casts both weaken them and set them up for your carry.
riktor.crest|Rift Walkers: Dash forward and pull nearby heroes toward you. A second pull to chain with Riplash, or to drag a group into Skewer; it also adds a ward.
riktor.crest|Typhoon: Basic attacks stack attack speed, and full stacks give a short dash. An odd fit for Riktor, who fights with abilities more than basic attacks.
riktor.Eternal|Nihil: Hitting a hero builds up power and armor the longer the fight lasts, and levels and takedowns make it permanently stronger. Fits Riktor staying in fights with Electrocute up.
riktor.minor|From the Abyss: Heals you over time while fighting heroes or hidden from enemies. Sustain during the long brawls Riktor stays in.
riktor.minor|Adaptive Plating: Taking hits stacks armor against that damage type. Good when Riktor is the one soaking the enemy's focus.
riktor.minor|Voracity: Generic: unit kills restore a little health and give a bit of gold. Nothing specific to Riktor's kit.
riktor.crest|Saphir's Mantle: Grow bigger and tankier for 6s while damaging nearby heroes, then keep some of that health permanently. Pop it right after Riplash pulls a target to you.
riktor.Eternal|Exarch: Healing or shielding speeds up your attacks and adds magic damage to them for 4s. Electrocute's shield triggers it on yourself, so keep whipping while the aura is up.
riktor.minor|Preservation: Your shields and heals are stronger. Electrocute's shield gets a bit bigger, plus any heals your team gives you.
riktor.minor|Delayed Fate: Part of incoming ability damage is spread out over a few seconds instead of hitting at once. Helps Riktor survive burst combos while he holds a target.

kwang.augment|Aura of the Heavens: You and nearby allies heal off all damage dealt. Kwang fights in the middle with abilities and basic attacks, so it keeps you and your team healthier in long brawls.
kwang.Eternal|Vesh: Every ability hit leaves a short burn. Judgement, Light of the Heavens, Surge and Fury of the Heavens all add extra damage after the combo lands.
kwang.minor|Lich: Magic lifesteal that grows with level. Judgement, Fury, Light of the Heavens while holding the Blade and his lightning strikes deal magic damage, so trading in lane keeps you topped up.
kwang.minor|Mind Rot: Vesh's burn also chips part of the target's current health, so it hits hardest when you open on healthy, beefy targets.
kwang.crest|Tempest: Zaps up to 3 nearby heroes every second and heals you. Pop it as you dive in with Surge of the Heavens to help you survive in the middle of a fight.
kwang.augment|Slayer of the Heavens: Your energized lightning basic attacks hit harder and cut your cooldowns more. Weave a basic attack after every ability so Judgement and Surge come back faster.
kwang.Eternal|Aion: Every spell cast boosts mana regen and your ability damage on heroes earns gold, so Kwang's ability-heavy trades pay for themselves.
kwang.minor|Sacrifice: Landing abilities on heroes refunds mana, and a kill refunds a lot more. It keeps you casting Judgement and Surge through long fights.
kwang.minor|Runic Focus: More magic power while your mana is high. Open a fight with full mana for the strongest combo; it fades as you spend.
kwang.crest|Typhoon: Your basic attacks build attack speed, and at full stacks you get a short dash. Fits Kwang's energized basic attacks between abilities.
kwang.minor|The Tenth Seal: From level 10, Fury of the Heavens hits harder and comes back sooner, so you can teleport to your Blade more often in fights.
kwang.minor|Millennia: Your ultimate's damage slowly grows over the game. A small late-game boost to Fury of the Heavens; nothing else changes.
kwang.crest|Winter's Fury: A growing ice zone that slows and makes enemies take more magic damage. Drop it, then hit them with Judgement and Fury of the Heavens while they are slowed.
kwang.Eternal|Xyris: Bonus damage that grows as you kill minions and monsters. A generic farming damage boost; nothing special with the kit.
kwang.minor|Furor: Short attack speed boost when a fight starts. Stacks with the energized blade's attack speed for a fast opening flurry.
kwang.minor|Cull the Weak: More damage to minions and monsters, and kills refund some mana. Helps clear waves and camps; nothing special in hero fights.
kwang.crest|Obelisk: Condemn powers up one Kwang basic attack to deal 50 damage plus scaling. If the target dies within 3s, Kwang collects a Soul: each Soul adds 6 damage to Condemn and 1 magical power, so save Condemn for low targets.

gadget.augment|Auto-Lock Amp: Once Seek and Destroy stops and locks on, the droid chases its target faster, so slippery heroes struggle to walk out of its damage and slow.
gadget.Eternal|Vesh: Part of every ability's damage to heroes also burns over a few seconds. Empowered Sticky Mines and Tesla Dome's long damage leave extra damage ticking.
gadget.minor|Tithe of Death: Takedowns refill mana and permanently shorten ability cooldowns, up to a cap. Gadget casts abilities more often the better fights go.
gadget.minor|Mind Rot: Vesh's burn also deals damage based on the target's current health, so it hits hardest against full-health tanks.
gadget.crest|Soulbearer: Activate for a shield, healing off magic damage and a bit of speed. Use it as Tesla Dome starts so its long damage window heals Gadget.
gadget.crest|Tranquility: Heals Gadget and nearby allies and briefly cuts damage they take. Use it mid-fight to save a teammate. Support crest with an extra ward slot.
gadget.Eternal|Xyris: Bonus damage that grows as Gadget kills minions and monsters. Generic farming scaling, not tied to any ability.
gadget.minor|Dominance: Every takedown heals Gadget, more when low on health. Lets Gadget keep fighting after a kill instead of backing off.
gadget.minor|Eviscerate: Bonus damage to targets above 80% health, so opening on healthy enemies with an empowered Sticky Mine or Seek and Destroy hits harder.
gadget.crest|Epoch: Freezes Gadget in place, untouchable, for a moment. Use it when divers jump on Gadget to waste their combo and wait for allies to help.
gadget.Eternal|Aion: Each ability cast adds mana regen, and ability damage to heroes earns gold. Rewards landing Sticky Mine and Seek and Destroy on heroes often in lane.
gadget.minor|Philosopher: Passive gold over time, faster with more ability cooldown reduction. Generic income, nothing special with Gadget's kit.
gadget.minor|Arcane Resonance: More mana regeneration makes basic ability cooldowns and Philosopher gold tick faster. Pairs with Aion's regen stacks from casting.
gadget.crest|Tempest: Activate in a brawl to zap up to three nearby heroes every second and heal off it. Best when enemies are stuck inside Tesla Dome near Gadget.
gadget.augment|Blast Zone: Sticky Mine explodes over a wider area, and empowering one on a hero with a basic attack gives extra passive stacks, so Gadget gains magic power faster.
gadget.minor|Sacrifice: Ability hits on heroes restore mana over time, more on kills. Keeps Gadget casting Sticky Mine and Seek and Destroy in long lanes.
gadget.minor|Runic Focus: More magic power while Gadget's mana bar is high. Rewards poking from full mana instead of spending it all at once.
gadget.minor|The Tenth Seal: At level 10, Tesla Dome hits a bit harder and comes back sooner.
gadget.minor|Millennia: Tesla Dome slowly gets stronger every minute of the game. A late-game pick, nothing for the early fights.
gadget.minor|Lich: Heals off magic damage dealt, rising with level. Tesla Dome's long damage and Seek and Destroy's damage over time give steady healing in fights.

rampage.augment|Tiny Titan: Behemoth makes you smaller and much faster attacking instead of bigger, but you take a lot more damage while it lasts. Turns your ultimate into a damage window for chasing and finishing, not a tanking window.
rampage.Eternal|Krix: More max health and a bigger body. Plain tankiness, and it makes Behemoth's healing and your passive regeneration worth more since both scale with max health.
rampage.minor|Regenerative Tissue: Heal a share of max health after a few seconds away from hero damage. Stacks with King of the Jungle's regeneration so you clear camps and reset between ganks without going back.
rampage.minor|Predator: Killing a camp leader gives a short burst of damage and move speed. Take a buff camp right before you gank so you arrive faster and hit harder.
rampage.crest|Saphir's Mantle: Grow and gain max health for a few seconds while damaging heroes near you, then keep some health permanently. Pop it as you Pounce in to soak damage and grow tankier every fight.
rampage.Eternal|Idrisil: Extra armor while healthy and a shield when you drop low. A safety net for Rampage diving with Pounce, on top of the healing his passive gives when he is crowd controlled.
rampage.minor|Frost Snap: Bonus damage to stunned or slowed targets. Boulder Throw stuns and Rumble slows, so nearly every follow-up hit you land benefits.
rampage.minor|Icy Touch: Your basic attacks lower the enemy's attack speed, stacking. Helps you win trades against fighters and carries who rely on basic attacks.
rampage.crest|Leafsong: A support crest: speeds up nearby allies and makes them ignore slows briefly, plus extra wards and less minion gold. Use it to rush your team into a Boulder Throw stun.
rampage.minor|Feeding Frenzy: Faster attacks for each enemy hero near you. Rampage fights in the middle of the enemy team, especially in Behemoth, so it is often near full value.
rampage.crest|Razorback: Short burst of armor plus reflected damage back at heroes hitting you. Use it when the enemy focuses you during Behemoth.
rampage.Eternal|Lotus: A random small stat bonus every couple of minutes and on every takedown. Nothing specific to Rampage's kit; it just grows slowly over the game.
rampage.minor|Masterpiece: Each kill gives a short stacking boost to damage and move speed, helping you chase the next target after a won fight.
rampage.minor|Prima Donna: More damage to heroes but you take more from everything. A risky pick on a frontline jungler who is meant to absorb hits.
rampage.crest|Ortus: Burst of move speed and physical power for a few seconds, with permanent power on takedowns. Use it to close the gap before Pounce or Boulder Throw.
rampage.minor|Cannibalism: Each takedown adds permanent max health. Plain tankiness that grows with your kill participation.
rampage.crest|Nyr Warboots: A burst of decaying move speed plus fast healing for a few seconds. Use it to reach a fight, or to escape and recover when Behemoth is down.
rampage.augment|Rock & Awe: Boulder Throw hits harder the farther it flies. Carry the boulder and throw from long range at a target walking toward you or fleeing, instead of point-blank.
rampage.minor|Festering Wounds: Your stuns and roots cut the target's healing for a few seconds. Boulder Throw's stun makes it reliable against lifesteal heroes and healers.
rampage.Eternal|Weald: When you hit a hero below 30% health, true-damage missiles fire that pass through walls, 10s cooldown per hero. Helps finish a low target who escapes after your Boulder Throw.
rampage.minor|Dryad's Boon: There's no game text for this minor in our data, so we can't say what it does for Rampage.
rampage.minor|Wind-Rider: Pounce counts as a leap, so you get bonus attack speed right after landing. Your first basic attacks after the knockback come in faster.
rampage.crest|Judgement: Damages everyone around you and heals you for each hero hit. Use it after Pounce lands you in the enemy team to top up.
rampage.minor|Cold Hearted: Enemies who basic attack you get slowed a little, stacking. Good when carries try to shoot you down, useless against ability damage.
rampage.crest|Brutallax: Removes crowd control and makes you very hard to crowd control for a few seconds, extended by your hits. Use it when stunned so you can keep fighting and land your Boulder Throw.

argus.augment|Infinite Obliteration: Synaptic Obliterator's beams reach anywhere, travel 50% faster and slow longer. You can snipe fleeing targets from safety during the channel.
argus.Eternal|Aion: Each cast stacks mana regen, and ability damage to heroes gives gold. Particle Shredder and Dread Nova poke feed it.
argus.minor|Bottomless Vial: Killing a river buff gives back a potion charge and permanent magical power. A small sustain and scaling bonus, nothing special with his kit.
argus.minor|Runic Focus: More magical power the more mana you have. Particle Shredder drains mana, so it is strongest before you start spending.
argus.crest|Soulbearer: A shield plus magical lifesteal and move speed for 8s. Pop it before Synaptic Obliterator so the beams heal you while you channel.
argus.augment|Arcane Engine: Ability damage to heroes gives stacking move speed. Particle Shredder's constant hits stack it fast so you can kite.
argus.minor|Philosopher: Generates gold over time, faster with ability cooldown speed. A generic economy boost.
argus.minor|Arcane Resonance: Your basic ability cooldowns get faster based on mana regen. Pairs with Aion to bring Dread Nova and Ether Crystal back sooner.
argus.crest|Epoch: Enter stasis for 2.5s, untouchable but unable to act. Use it when a diver reaches you, then answer with Dread Nova's stun.
argus.Eternal|Vesh: Ability damage on heroes leaves a small burn that grows with game time. Argus deals nearly all his damage through abilities, so it adds up.
argus.minor|Tithe of Death: Takedowns restore mana and permanently speed up ability cooldowns. Rewards an Argus who lands Dread Nova stuns into kills.
argus.minor|Mind Rot: Vesh's burn also takes 2% of the target's current health. Extra damage on every ability hit.
argus.crest|Tranquility: A heal for you and nearby heroes with brief damage reduction, plus an extra ward and less minion gold. A support crest; use the heal when Ether Crystal starts the fight.
argus.augment|Mana Catalyst: Damage to heroes restores mana, and basic attacks restore more. It keeps Particle Shredder firing longer.
argus.Eternal|Lotus: Every couple of minutes and every takedown, a random small stat bonus. Generic scaling with nothing special for his kit.
argus.minor|Early Bloom: An extra level when you reach level 12. Gets your next ability ranks sooner; otherwise generic.
argus.minor|Prima Donna: You deal 10% more damage to heroes but take 6% more. A glass cannon pick for an Argus who stays back.
argus.minor|Lich: Magical lifesteal that grows with level. Argus deals magical damage through abilities, so it heals him in fights.

countess.augment|Sanguine Slash: Blade Siphon hits harder and heals more against a lone target. Use it to duel enemies caught away from their team, especially after Shadow Slip closes the gap.
countess.Eternal|Vesh: Part of each ability's damage to heroes burns over time, on top of Haemorrhage. Her fast Blade Siphon and Eventide casts keep it going.
countess.minor|Lich: Heals Countess off magic damage dealt, rising with level. Countess's abilities deal magic damage, so every ability hit adds healing.
countess.minor|Millennia: Feast slowly gets stronger every minute of the game. A late-game pick, nothing for the early fights.
countess.crest|Tempest: Activate in a brawl to zap up to three nearby heroes every second and heal off it. Use it after Shadow Slip puts her in the middle of enemies.
countess.augment|Blood Well: Takedowns leave a blood pool that rapidly restores health and mana while she stands in it. Keep fighting near the pool after a kill to reset for the next one.
countess.minor|Mind Rot: Vesh's burn also deals damage based on the target's current health, so it hits hardest against full-health tanks.
countess.crest|Typhoon: Basic attacks build stacking attack speed, and at full stacks she dashes. Rewards weaving basic attacks between Blade Siphon and Eventide in longer fights.
countess.crest|Winter's Fury: Releases a growing zone that hurts and slows enemies and makes them take more magic damage. Her whole kit deals magic damage, so activate it before her combo.
countess.minor|Tithe of Death: Takedowns refill mana and permanently shorten ability cooldowns, up to a cap. Countess casts abilities more often the better fights go.
countess.crest|Soulbearer: Activate for a shield, healing off magic damage and speed. Use it as she dives with Feast so Blade Siphon and Eventide heal her even more.
countess.crest|Epoch: Freezes Countess in place, untouchable, for a moment. Use it when divers jump on Countess to waste their combo and wait for allies to help.

zinx.augment|Terminal Treatment: Your basic attack poison hits harder the lower the target's health is. Keep attacking a wounded enemy instead of switching targets to finish them.
zinx.crest|Typhoon: Basic attacks build stacks of attack speed, and at full stacks you get a short dash. Lets Zinx keep her poison stacking while repositioning away from divers.
zinx.augment|Heal Matrix: Infuse gets two charges but each heal is smaller. Lets you save one for an emergency or double-heal a focused ally in one burst.
zinx.Eternal|Exarch: Every Infuse heal gives the target faster attacks and extra magical damage on hit for a few seconds. Heal your carry right as the fight starts to boost their damage.
zinx.minor|Revelation: Each ability cast trims your other basic abilities' cooldowns a little. Cycling Ricochet, Bad Medicine and Infuse gets them back slightly sooner.
zinx.minor|Fervour: Basic attacks on enemy heroes heal you and nearby allies a little. Zinx pokes with basic attacks in lane, so it adds steady small healing to your laning partner.
zinx.crest|Tranquility: A support crest: an area heal on yourself and nearby allies plus brief damage reduction, extra wards and less minion gold. Save it for when an enemy commits on your carry.
zinx.minor|Preservation: Healing and shields you receive are 10% stronger. Helps when your own Neural Regenesis revives you or allies heal you; it does not boost your Infuse on others.
zinx.Eternal|Thraex: Your basic attacks mark the target, so you deal more to them and take less from them. Helps Zinx win basic-attack trades in lane.
zinx.minor|Savage Strikes: Small extra damage and healing on each basic attack that grows while you keep hitting a hero. A minor lane sustain boost for an auto-attacking support.
zinx.minor|Ferocity: Attack speed that keeps climbing the longer you stay in hero combat, which stacks your poison faster in long fights.
zinx.minor|The King: Basic attacks on enemy heroes give you gold. Rewards Zinx poking in lane with her attacks; a plain gold boost.
zinx.Eternal|Weald: When you damage a hero below 30% health, true-damage missiles fly at them through walls. Zinx keeps poking with basic attacks, so it helps finish low enemies who try to escape.
zinx.minor|Dryad's Boon: No game text is available for this minor yet, so we can't say what it does for Zinx.
zinx.minor|Taproot: Basic attacks heal you a little on hit. Small lane sustain while you poke; it scales with physical power Zinx rarely builds.
zinx.augment|Disc Of Demise: Ricochet bounces farther and every hit lowers its cooldown, more on heroes. Throw it into groups for stuns more often in teamfights.
zinx.crest|Epoch: Put yourself in stasis for a moment. Use it when divers jump on you, or to dodge a big ultimate, then Infuse your allies after.
zinx.minor|Illumination: Health regeneration equal to your bonus mana regeneration. Pays off if your support build stacks mana regeneration items.
zinx.minor|Forage: Extra gold and XP from minions and monsters. A plain farming boost, nothing tied to the kit.
zinx.minor|Barkskin: Enemies who basic attack you take a little damage back. Mildly punishes divers and carries who hit you; nothing special with the kit.
zinx.Eternal|Vesh: Your ability damage on heroes leaves a burn afterward. Ricochet bouncing and Bad Medicine's two hits each add their own burn.
zinx.minor|Lich: Your magical damage heals you, growing with level. Zinx's poison and abilities deal magical damage, so it adds sustain while poking.
zinx.minor|Mind Rot: The Vesh burn also takes a share of the target's current health, so it hurts most against healthy tanks hit by Ricochet.
zinx.Eternal|Lotus: A random small stat bonus every couple of minutes and on every takedown. Nothing specific to Zinx's kit.
zinx.minor|Masterpiece: Each kill gives a short stacking boost to damage and move speed. Helps you reach the next fight after a takedown.
zinx.minor|Prima Donna: More damage to heroes but you take more from everything. Risky on a support who divers will target.

narbash.augment|Percussive Tear: Every hit of Crash Bang Boom! lowers enemy armors briefly. Your team deals more damage to everyone caught in the drum solo.
narbash.Eternal|Exarch: Healing or shielding a target gives them 10% attack speed and extra magic damage on basic attacks for 4s. Song health regeneration may not count as healing, so pair it with Tranquility or Sanctification.
narbash.minor|Preservation: Healing and shields you receive are stronger. A defensive pick for a frontline support.
narbash.minor|Delayed Fate: Part of ability damage you take arrives slowly instead of all at once. Helps Narbash survive burst while channeling Crash Bang Boom!.
narbash.crest|Tranquility: Heals you and nearby allies and briefly cuts damage taken. Use it in a team fight to save a teammate after the enemy burst, plus extra wards for support.
narbash.minor|Omnipresent: Generic: more movement speed when out of combat, for roaming between lanes.
narbash.crest|Sanctification: Shields nearby allies and makes them resist crowd control while it holds. Pop it before the enemy engages or as your team goes in.
narbash.augment|Thonk: Thunk drops after hitting an enemy; pick it up for a lower cooldown and mana refund. Walk forward after a stun to grab it and Thunk again sooner.
narbash.crest|Leafsong: Speeds up nearby allies and makes them immune to slows. Stacks with March! for fast engages or escapes, plus extra wards for support.

boris.augment|Apex Hunter: Chrono Swipe hits much harder against heroes below 20% health. Save the dash to finish a fleeing target instead of opening with it.
boris.crest|Liberator: Cleanses crowd control and gives you a shield. Use it when you get stopped mid-dive, then dash back in with Chrono Swipe.
boris.Eternal|Weald: When you damage a hero below 30% health, true-damage missiles fly at them through walls. Canister attack speed adds more missiles, so it helps finish runners.
boris.minor|Dryad's Boon: No game text is available for this minor yet, so we can't say what it does for Boris.
boris.minor|Wind-Rider: A short attack speed burst after a dash or leap. Chrono Swipe is a dash, so open with it and build your Canisters faster.
boris.Eternal|Thraex: Your hits mark the hero you hit: more damage to them, less from them. Good for Boris locking onto one target with fast attacks.
boris.minor|Savage Strikes: Each basic attack adds a bit of damage that grows while you hit heroes, and heals you. Boris attacks fast at full Canisters, so it triggers constantly.
boris.minor|Ferocity: Attack speed keeps climbing for every second you stay in a hero fight. Stacks on top of your Canister attack speed in long duels.
boris.crest|Eviscerator: Pop it when you commit: faster attacks, healing from your damage, and stronger basic attacks. Helps you reach max Canisters quickly.
boris.crest|Iceskorn Talons: Drop an ice sheet where you fight: allies on it gain power and speed, enemies on it are slowed. Best when your team follows you in.
boris.crest|Pacifier: Dash in and your next physical hit deals extra damage, far more against nearly dead heroes. A kill lets you recast it to chase the next target.
boris.augment|Savage Shred: Hitting your Detection Protocol target shreds their armor for a few seconds. Mark a squishy, run the trail to them, and your whole combo hits harder.
boris.Eternal|Lotus: Generic: every 2 minutes and every takedown you get a random small boost to damage, cooldowns, speed or health. Nothing specific to Boris.
boris.minor|Early Bloom: Generic: one extra level when you reach level 12. Ultimate and ability ranks come a bit sooner, nothing specific to Boris.
boris.minor|Prima Donna: You deal more damage to heroes but take more from everything. A risky boost for a Boris who dives in and wins fast.

valmont.augment|Sanguine Banquet: Healing on all damage that grows with bonus mana, and kills raise his max mana. Pays off on a mana-stacking Valmont who drains through long fights.
valmont.Eternal|Vesh: Ability damage to heroes also adds a short burn. Rupture, Bloodbound, Arterial Grip and Exsanguinate all add extra damage after they land.
valmont.minor|The Tenth Seal: From level 10, Exsanguinate hits harder and comes back faster, so you can send more bat swarms in a fight.
valmont.minor|Millennia: Exsanguinate's damage grows slowly over the game. A late-game scaling pick for his bat ult.
valmont.crest|Epoch: Puts you in Stasis for 2.5s. Use it when divers jump you to wait out their burst.
valmont.Eternal|Aion: Casting builds mana regen and spell damage to heroes earns gold. Valmont casts constantly and Exsanguinate drains mana, so this keeps him in the fight.
valmont.minor|Bottomless Vial: Taking a river buff refills a potion and adds a little magical power permanently. Small sustain and scaling, nothing Valmont-specific.
valmont.minor|Perfection: Faster ability cooldowns while near full health. Good for poking with Rupture and Bloodbound before you take damage.
valmont.crest|Soulbearer: A shield, magical lifesteal and speed for 8s. Most of Valmont's damage is magic, so pair it with Exsanguinate for big healing in a fight.
valmont.Eternal|Lotus: Random small boosts every few minutes and on takedowns: damage, ability cooldowns, speed or health. A generic scaling pick.
valmont.minor|Early Bloom: Generic: an extra level when you hit level 12.
valmont.minor|Immaculate: Take less damage while near full health. Helps when trading at range before committing.
valmont.Eternal|Demiurge: Boosts the stats your items give and their damage effects. A generic build-amplifier.
valmont.minor|Construct: Generic: a little health and ability cooldown speed every level.
valmont.minor|Memory Leak: Ability casts permanently add max mana. Valmont's frequent casts build it, which also feeds Sanguine Banquet's healing.
valmont.minor|Lich: Magical lifesteal that grows with level. Valmont's abilities and Lilith's strikes are magic damage, so most of his damage heals him.
valmont.minor|Phylactery: After using your ult, cooldowns tick faster briefly and you gain a shield based on max mana. Fire Exsanguinate, then quickly recast your basic abilities.
valmont.crest|Typhoon: Basic attacks stack attack speed, and at full stacks you dash. More attack speed means faster Lilith strikes from his passive.

maco.augment|Ferocious Flight: Maco Fly gives a bigger shield and comes back sooner for every enemy it hits. Jump into groups instead of single targets to tank more and fly more often.
maco.Eternal|Exarch: Healing or shielding grants faster attacks and extra magical damage on hit. Maco Gift heals and Maco Fly shields trigger it, buffing yourself or the ally you heal.
maco.minor|Revelation: Each ability cast trims your other basic abilities' cooldowns a little. Cycling Maco Gift, Maco Fly and Maco Sparkle gets them back slightly sooner.
maco.minor|Omnipresent: Extra move speed out of combat. Helps you roam between lanes; stacks with the speed from your Mach Speed passive.
maco.crest|Tranquility: A support crest: an area heal on yourself and nearby allies plus brief damage reduction, extra wards and less minion gold. Save it for when your team is focused.
maco.minor|Fervour: Basic attacks on enemy heroes heal you and nearby allies a little. Adds small sustain to your lane when you poke with basic attacks.
maco.augment|Longshot: Maco Sparkle hits harder the farther it flies. Throw it at max range and let it explode at the end for damage and a longer stun.
maco.Eternal|Demiurge: Your items give more stats and their effects hit harder. A generic scaling boost, nothing tied to the kit.
maco.minor|Construct: Health and ability cooldown reduction every level. A plain stat boost, nothing special with the kit.
maco.minor|Memory Leak: Each ability cast permanently adds some max mana, and enough bonus mana grants move speed. Spamming Maco Gift builds it fastest.
maco.crest|Typhoon: Basic attacks build stacks of attack speed, and at full stacks you get a short dash. Gives a basic-attack Maco a mobility tool on top of Maco Fly.
maco.Eternal|Weald: When you hit a hero below 30% health, missiles fire that pass through walls. Helps finish low enemies after a Maco Strike or Maco Sparkle stun.
maco.minor|Dryad's Boon: No game text is available for Dryad's Boon yet, so its exact effect can't be confirmed. Judge it by its pick rate and win rate rather than a described interaction.
maco.minor|Taproot: Basic attacks heal you a little on hit. Small sustain that scales with physical power Maco rarely builds.
maco.crest|Warlock Crest: Ability damage and kills heal you a little; after enough healing it upgrades at base. Maco's frequent Maco Gift hits fill it over time.

kira.augment|Siphoning Purge: Purge heals you for 25% of its damage to heroes. Since you are slowed and cannot attack during Purge, this keeps you alive while you channel into a group.
kira.Eternal|Marrow: Heals you for part of your damage to heroes, more the lower your health. Mercy shots and Purge both deal heavy damage, so it keeps you dueling when low.
kira.minor|Blood Bank: Recent hero damage turns into extra lifesteal. A Mercy plus Dusk burst makes your following basic attacks heal more.
kira.minor|The Maw: Basic attacks deal extra true damage to targets below 40% health. It helps finish targets after Dusk detonates your Vengeance stacks.
kira.crest|Pacifier: A short dash that empowers your next physical hit, much stronger below 20% health. Dash, then Mercy or a basic to execute, and a kill lets you recast it.
kira.Eternal|Vermis: Every third basic attack in a row on the same hero deals a chunk of their max health. Fits Kira's steady attacking between Mercy shots, strongest into tanks.
kira.minor|Serration: Vermis also takes some of the target's missing health, making your third hit a stronger finisher on wounded targets.
kira.minor|Melting Point: Bonus damage against targets with high physical armor. Pick it when your main targets are armor-stacking tanks.
kira.Eternal|Weald: Hitting a hero below 30% health fires true-damage missiles at them that pass through walls. A good follow-up when a target flees after Dusk.
kira.minor|Forage: Plain extra gold and XP from minions and monsters; a farming boost with nothing special for her kit.
kira.minor|Wind-Rider: After Shadow Glide, you attack faster for 4s. Dash in or out, then pour basic attacks into a target to build Vengeance stacks for Dusk.
kira.augment|Bringer Of Mercy: Mercy costs less mana and each hit shaves time off your other cooldowns. Landing Mercy brings Dusk and Shadow Glide back faster.
kira.augment|Lenore: Shadow Glide refreshes Nevermore and its Raven hits harder. Dash, then immediately fire an empowered basic or Mercy for a burst of Raven damage.
kira.crest|Eviscerator: Attack faster, heal from all damage, and add damage to each attack for 6s. Stacks Vengeance faster before you cast Dusk.
kira.Eternal|Lotus: Every couple of minutes and every takedown, a random small stat bonus. Generic scaling with nothing special for her kit.
kira.minor|Masterpiece: Kills grant stacking damage and move speed for a while. Pairs with Shadow Glide resetting on takedowns to chain through a fight.
kira.minor|Prima Donna: You deal 10% more damage to heroes but take 6% more. A glass cannon pick that only works if your team protects you.
kira.crest|Liberator: Removes every debuff and gives you a shield. Use it when caught by crowd control, especially if you need to finish a Purge channel.
kira.minor|Breach: Purge's damage cuts an enemy hero's physical armor by 35% for 4s. The rest of Purge and your follow-up attacks hit harder.

morigesh.augment|Ritual Of Death: Curse heals you for most of its damage, and takedowns cut its cooldown. Mark a target, Curse them, and use the heal to stay in the fight.
morigesh.Eternal|Pilow: Each ability cast weakens nearby enemy heroes' damage, stacking. Morigesh casts Mark and Hive often, so she can keep enemies weakened while she brawls.
morigesh.minor|Harmonic Currents: Every cast restores some missing health and mana. Fits Morigesh's steady spam of Mark and Hive in lane.
morigesh.minor|Convection: Gain armor for every Pilow stack on nearby enemies. Rewards casting often while standing close, such as during Swarm.
morigesh.crest|Tempest: Damages up to 3 nearby heroes each second and heals you. Pop it before Swarm through the enemy team.
morigesh.Eternal|Lotus: Random small boosts every few minutes and on takedowns: damage, ability cooldowns, speed or health. A generic scaling pick.
morigesh.minor|Early Bloom: Generic: an extra level when you hit level 12.
morigesh.minor|Immaculate: Take less damage while near full health. Helps when poking with Mark and Hive.
morigesh.crest|Soulbearer: A shield, magical lifesteal and speed for 8s. Her abilities all deal magic damage, so pop it before Swarm and Curse to heal through the burst.
morigesh.augment|Cursed Infestation: Hive hits harder and reaches further. Better poke and easier slows from a safe distance.
morigesh.Eternal|Vesh: Ability damage to heroes also adds a short burn. Stacks on top of Pestilence, making Mark, Hive and Swarm hit harder over time.
morigesh.minor|Lich: Magical lifesteal that grows with level. Morigesh deals mostly magic damage, adding to her healing from Mark and Swarm.
morigesh.minor|Mind Rot: The Vesh burn also deals damage based on the target's current health. Strongest when opening on healthy targets.
morigesh.crest|Epoch: Freeze yourself in stasis for 2.5s. Use it when focused, then Swarm out or back in.
morigesh.minor|The Tenth Seal: From level 10, Curse hits harder and comes back faster, so you can finish Marked targets more often.

iggy-scorch.augment|Hold This!: Every Molotov explosion that hits a hero makes future Molotovs permanently stronger. Land it on heroes early and often in lane to scale it up.
iggy-scorch.crest|Epoch: Your panic button. When divers jump you, freeze yourself to wait out their burst while your turrets keep shooting.
iggy-scorch.Eternal|Aion: Each cast boosts your mana regen for a while, and ability damage on heroes gives gold. Spamming Molotov and Oil Spill keeps you fed and casting.
iggy-scorch.minor|Philosopher: Generic: a small trickle of gold over time, faster with more ability cooldown reduction. Nothing specific to Iggy & Scorch.
iggy-scorch.minor|Runic Focus: More magical power the fuller your mana bar. Pairs with mana regen and items that give mana.
iggy-scorch.augment|Badlands Belch: Inferno's final belch hits harder against hurt heroes and knocks them further back. Use it to finish targets after the flamethrower or to peel divers off you.
iggy-scorch.minor|Sacrifice: Hitting heroes with abilities refills missing mana over a few seconds, and kills refill a big chunk. Keeps Molotov and turret spam going.
iggy-scorch.augment|Turret Maniac: You can have 4 turrets out, but each is easier to kill. Spread them around a fight or objective to zone the area.
iggy-scorch.crest|Soulbearer: A shield, lifesteal on your magic damage, and some speed for a few seconds. Pop it when caught, and your turrets and fire heal you.
iggy-scorch.minor|Bottomless Vial: Killing a river buff refills a potion and adds permanent magical power. Helps a mage who takes the river buffs.
iggy-scorch.Eternal|Vesh: Every ability that hits a hero adds a burn. Turret fireballs, Molotov's fire and Inferno all hit repeatedly, so the burn stays up.
iggy-scorch.minor|Lich: Heals you from magic damage. Turrets, fire fields and Inferno are all magic damage, so it gives steady sustain.
iggy-scorch.minor|Mind Rot: Your Vesh burn also deals damage based on the target's current health, so your fire hurts healthy, tanky heroes more.
iggy-scorch.minor|Arcane Resonance: More mana regen makes your basic ability cooldowns and Philosopher's gold tick faster. Pairs with Aion's mana regen stacks.

akeron.augment|Death From Above: Web Lash gets a second shot from a wall, so you can swing to another wall or root an enemy from above. It makes ganks and escapes much harder to predict.
akeron.Eternal|Nihil: Staying in fights with heroes builds up power and armor over time, and each level-up or takedown makes it permanently stronger. Suits Akeron's long brawls with Hellfire and Crushing Maw.
akeron.minor|From the Abyss: Heals a share of your max health every second while fighting heroes or hidden, which adds to Crushing Maw's healing and keeps you brawling longer.
akeron.minor|Adaptive Plating: Getting hit gives you armor of the matching type, stacking up quickly. Helps Akeron survive diving in to bite with Consume.
