akeron.crest|Iceskorn Talons: Drops an ice sheet that slows enemies a little and speeds up and powers up allies. Pop it on a gank so Hellfire and Web Lash's slowing field are harder to walk out of.
akeron.Eternal|Demiurge: Makes all your item stats and item effects stronger. Generic power boost; nothing special with the kit.
akeron.minor|Construct: Extra health and ability cooldown reduction every level. Generic stats; nothing special with the kit.
akeron.minor|Bloatware: More damage and damage reduction for each item you own. A generic late-game boost; nothing special with the kit.
akeron.crest|Tempest: Zaps up to 3 nearby heroes every second and heals you for part of it. Pop it as you close in with Web Lash so the brawl around Crushing Maw keeps you healthy.
akeron.Eternal|Krix: A plain tankiness boost: Akeron gains 5% more max health, plus 1% more per level, and grows slightly larger as max health rises. Nothing special with the kit.
akeron.minor|Voracity: Each enemy unit Akeron kills restores 0.75% of max health and gives 2 gold. Helps Akeron stay healthy while clearing minions and camps; nothing special with the kit.
akeron.minor|Cannibalism: Every takedown permanently adds 25 max health to Akeron. Consume executes heroes bitten at low health, so each bite that finishes a hero also grows Akeron's health for the rest of the game.
akeron.crest|Nyr Warboots: Resilience gives Akeron 50% movement speed that fades over 5s and restores 3% of max health every second for 5s. Use Resilience to close in for Web Lash or Consume, or to escape and heal.

mourn.augment|Nightmare Extractor: Every ability cast brings your empowered Extract attack back sooner. Weave Contagion, Abduct and Beguile with basic attacks for more healing hits.
mourn.Eternal|Krix: Raises your max health as you level and makes you bigger. Extract heals off max health, so it gets stronger too.
mourn.minor|Regenerative Tissue: Heals you over time once you go a while without hero damage. Generic sustain between fights.
mourn.minor|Cannibalism: Each takedown permanently adds a bit of max health. Generic tankiness that grows with takedowns.
mourn.crest|Saphir's Mantle: Briefly grows your health and size and damages nearby heroes, then keeps part of that as permanent health. Pop it during a Beguile channel in the middle of the enemy team.
mourn.Eternal|Lotus: Gives you a random small stat every couple of minutes and on takedowns. Generic slow scaling; nothing special with the kit.
mourn.minor|Early Bloom: You skip ahead one level at 12. Generic power spike; nothing special with the kit.
mourn.minor|Fragrance: More magic damage to nearby heroes. Mourn's Contagion, Beguile, Abduct and Extract are all magic, so it boosts your close-range brawl.
mourn.crest|Winter's Fury: A growing ice zone that slows and makes enemies take more magic damage. Drop it, then Beguile and Contagion hit harder.
mourn.augment|Nightstalker: Eclipse gives much more movement speed, so you can cross the map while enemies are blinded and start a fight with Abduct before they react.
mourn.Eternal|Knell: Your hits strip the enemy's armor and give you some of it. Contagion hitting several heroes spreads the shred, so your team deals more damage.
mourn.minor|Patina: A shield and a bit of movement speed after a while without damage. Generic safety; nothing special with the kit.
mourn.minor|Peal: Eclipse comes back faster, and after casting it your hits apply full armor shred at once, so the fight you start in the dark goes your team's way.
mourn.crest|Sanctification: Shields you and nearby allies and makes crowd control wear off faster. Pop it as you engage with Abduct or Beguile; it also gives an extra ward.
mourn.augment|Dreadful Roots: If Abduct hits a wall, you pull yourself to it. Use it to cross terrain on ganks or escape over walls.
mourn.crest|Leafsong: Speeds up nearby allies and makes them immune to slows. Use it to catch an enemy with your team or to run away; it also gives an extra ward.
mourn.Eternal|Nihil: Staying in fights with heroes builds up power and armor over time, and level-ups or takedowns make it permanently stronger. Fits Mourn's long brawls.
mourn.minor|From the Abyss: Heals a share of your max health every second while fighting heroes or hidden, on top of Extract and Contagion healing.
mourn.minor|Adaptive Plating: Getting hit gives you armor of the matching type. Helps you survive charging Beguile in the middle of the enemy team.
mourn.Eternal|Vesh: Every ability hit leaves a short burn. Contagion, Abduct and Beguile all add extra damage after they land.
mourn.minor|Tithe of Death: Takedowns refund mana and permanently shorten your ability cooldowns, up to a cap. Snowballs your Contagion and Beguile uptime.
mourn.minor|Mind Rot: Vesh's burn also chips part of the target's current health, so it hurts most when you open on healthy targets.

neon.augment|RAM: Each takedown permanently adds magic power and mana regen, and enough stacks add move speed. Dying loses half the stacks, so it rewards a Neon who snowballs and stays alive.
neon.Eternal|Aion: Each cast adds mana regen and ability damage to heroes earns gold. Neon casts constantly to build Threads, so this keeps her mana and gold flowing.
neon.minor|Bottomless Vial: Taking a river buff refills a potion and grants permanent magic power. A jungle or roaming habit, not tied to her abilities.
neon.minor|Runic Focus: More magic power while Neon's mana bar is high. Rewards poking from full mana instead of spending it all at once.
neon.crest|Soulbearer: Activate for a shield, healing off magic damage and speed. Use it with Final Thread so the Overclocked burst heals her back up.
neon.Eternal|Lotus: Random small stat boosts every couple of minutes and on each takedown. Generic slow scaling, nothing special with Neon's abilities.
neon.minor|Flawless: Each ability that hits a hero heals Neon and nearby allies a little, once per cast. Her quick L.I.N.X casts make it trigger often.
neon.minor|Fragrance: More magic and true damage to nearby heroes. L.I.N.X's return and Overclocked pulse deal true damage, so it boosts them most when she fights close.
neon.crest|Time-Flux Band: Mark a spot, then teleport back a few seconds later with basic ability cooldowns reset and some mana back. Dive in, burn every ability, snap back, then repeat.
neon.Eternal|Satariel: Each takedown makes her hit harder but lowers her max health, and stacks vanish on death. A high-risk snowball for a Neon who poke-fights from range.
neon.minor|Demonic Bargain: Extra gold at levels 1 and 10. Generic gold boost, nothing tied to her kit.
neon.minor|Rite: Abilities cost some health, but she permanently gains ability cooldown reduction. More casts means more Threads and more Overclocked abilities.
neon.crest|Epoch: Freezes Neon in place, untouchable, for a moment. Use it when divers jump on Neon to waste their combo and wait for allies to help.
neon.augment|Dox: Swaps her trinket for one that reveals nearby enemy heroes, plus extra magic power and mana. Good for scouting before diving with Erase Vector.
neon.augment|Ghost in the Machine: Dashing with Erase Vector turns Neon invisible for 1s, so enemies lose sight of her while she repositions before the empowered Jolt.
neon.minor|Early Bloom: Grants a free extra level at level 12. Generic power spike, nothing tied to Neon's abilities.
neon.minor|Immaculate: Neon takes less damage while near full health. Helps survive the first hits of a trade or dive.
neon.Eternal|Vesh: Part of each ability's damage to heroes burns over time. Her frequent L.I.N.X and Data Burst hits keep it ticking.
neon.minor|Lich: Heals off magic damage dealt, rising with level. L.I.N.X, Data Burst and Erase Vector's explosion all deal magic damage, so her poke heals her.
neon.minor|Millennia: Final Thread's bomb slowly gets stronger every minute of the game. A late-game pick, nothing for the early fights.

twinblast.augment|Grenadier: An extra Vortex Grenade charge, and Rocket Dash gives one back. More grenades means more ability casts, which keeps Gunslinger's triple shot coming.
twinblast.Eternal|Weald: Hitting a hero below 30% health fires shots through walls. Its extra projectiles scale with bonus attack speed, which TwinBlast builds.
twinblast.minor|Forage: Plain economy: a bit more gold and XP from each minion or monster kill.
twinblast.minor|Wind-Rider: Gain attack speed after Rocket Dash. Dash, then fire quickly while the boost and Gunslinger stack together.
twinblast.crest|Pacifier: A short dash that empowers your next physical hit, much stronger on targets below 20% health. A second dash to go with Rocket Dash for finishing kills.
twinblast.augment|Amplified Burst: Vaporize reaches further. Poke from a safer distance and hit more targets in a line.
twinblast.minor|Dryad's Boon: No game text is on record for this minor, so we can't say what it does for TwinBlast.
twinblast.crest|Liberator: Removes slows, stuns and other debuffs and gives a short shield. Save it for when you get caught, then Rocket Dash out.
twinblast.Eternal|Lotus: Random small boosts every few minutes and on takedowns: damage, ability cooldowns, speed or health. A generic scaling pick.
twinblast.minor|Masterpiece: Kills give stacking damage and speed for a short time. Helps TwinBlast roll from one kill to the next in a team fight.
twinblast.minor|Prima Donna: More damage to heroes, more damage taken. Rewards staying back and shooting; punishing if caught.
twinblast.augment|Spray 'N Pray: Ventilate deals much more damage but spreads at long range. Get close before ulting so most bullets land.
twinblast.Eternal|Vermis: Every third basic attack in a row on the same hero adds damage based on their max health. Casting abilities speeds up TwinBlast's attacks, so it procs often; strongest into tanks.
twinblast.minor|Serration: Adds missing-health damage on top of Vermis procs, helping finish hurt targets.
twinblast.minor|Melting Point: Extra damage only into enemies stacked with physical armor. Pick it into armored tanks.
twinblast.crest|Ortus: A burst of speed and physical power, and takedowns during it grant permanent power. Pop it when going in with Vaporize and Ventilate.
twinblast.crest|Eviscerator: A burst of attack speed, healing on all damage, and extra on-hit damage for 6s. Vaporize applies on-hit effects at 200% effectiveness, so it hits hard during this.

dekker.augment|Nothin' But Net: Each Stasis Bomb that hits a hero gives gold and permanent magic power. Rewards landing long-range bombs often.
dekker.Eternal|Lotus: Random small stat boosts every couple of minutes and on each takedown. Generic slow scaling, nothing special with Dekker's abilities.
dekker.minor|Flawless: Each ability hitting a hero heals Dekker and nearby allies a little. Her Photon Disruptor and Stasis Bomb pokes give the team small sustain in lane.
dekker.minor|Prima Donna: Dekker deals more damage to heroes but takes more damage. A risky pick for a support who should poke from range with Stasis Bomb and Photon Disruptor.
dekker.crest|Leafsong: Speeds up nearby allies and makes them immune to slows for a few seconds. Use it to engage together or escape. Support crest with an extra ward slot.
dekker.Eternal|Aion: Each cast adds mana regen and ability hits on heroes earn gold. Helps a low-farm support Dekker keep up on items.
dekker.minor|Philosopher: Passive gold over time, faster with more ability cooldown reduction. Generic income, nothing special with Dekker's kit.
dekker.minor|Arcane Resonance: More mana regeneration makes basic ability cooldowns and Philosopher gold tick faster. Pairs with Aion's regen stacks from casting.
dekker.crest|Tranquility: Heals Dekker and nearby allies and briefly cuts damage they take. Use it mid-fight to save a teammate. Support crest with an extra ward slot.
dekker.Eternal|Vesh: Part of each ability's damage to heroes burns over time. Photon Disruptor and Ion Strike hits leave extra damage ticking.
dekker.minor|Tithe of Death: Takedowns refill mana and permanently shorten ability cooldowns, up to a cap. Dekker casts abilities more often the better fights go.
dekker.minor|Mind Rot: Vesh's burn also deals damage based on the target's current health, so it hits hardest against full-health tanks.
dekker.crest|Sanctification: Shields Dekker and nearby allies and makes them harder to stun or slow while it holds. Pop it as a fight starts. Support crest with an extra ward slot.
dekker.augment|Polarity Strike: Ion Strike also shields allied heroes, more when they are hurt. Drop it on a teammate under attack to stun the enemy and protect the ally at once.
dekker.Eternal|Knell: Attacks and abilities on heroes stack armor shred, and Dekker gains the armor removed. Photon Disruptor and basic attacks stack it fast so allies hit harder.
dekker.minor|Patina: After a while without taking damage she gets a small shield and extra speed while it holds. Helps her walk up to land Stasis Bomb safely.
dekker.minor|Peal: Ion Strike comes back sooner, and casting it makes her attacks and abilities apply full Rust instantly. Open fights with Ion Strike for maximum armor shred.

kaelen.augment|Neverending Chase: Every basic attack and ability hit on a hero lowers Winter's Pursuit's cooldown. Razorstorm's many hits refund it fast, so you can lunge again to root a frostbitten target.
kaelen.Eternal|Krix: More max health and a bigger body. Plain tankiness that helps you survive diving in with Winter's Pursuit and landing in the middle of the enemy with Frostfall.
kaelen.minor|Regenerative Tissue: Heal a share of max health after a few seconds away from hero damage. Lets you clear camps and reset between ganks without going back.
kaelen.minor|Predator: Killing a camp leader gives a short burst of damage and move speed. Take a buff camp right before you gank so you arrive faster and hit harder.
kaelen.crest|Gravitum: Fire a long-range shot that grounds the first hero hit, stopping dashes and leaps. Use it to keep a target from escaping before Winter's Pursuit or Frostfall lands.
kaelen.augment|Last Winter: Allies in the Frostfall targeting zone get 20% more movement speed for 3s to follow the leap. On landing, Kaelen gains a shield of 10% max health plus 4% per hero hit, lasting 4s.
kaelen.crest|Judgement: Thunder Cleaver deals damage in an area around Kaelen and heals Kaelen on a hero hit, with further hero hits healing at 50% strength. Fits Razorstorm and Winter's Pursuit, which keep Kaelen up close.

ikra.augment|Cascade: Basic attacks build toward an empowered Brine hit, and ability hits grant stacking attack speed. Weave Fathom shots between abilities for steady poke.
ikra.Eternal|Aion: Spell casts build mana regen and spell damage to heroes earns gold. Ikra spams Brine on a short cooldown, so this keeps his mana up while he pokes.
ikra.minor|Philosopher: Generic: passive gold over time, a bit faster with ability cooldown speed.
ikra.minor|Arcane Resonance: Basic ability cooldowns tick faster with more mana regen. Pairs with Aion so Brine, Narcosis and Hydroclasm come back sooner.
ikra.crest|Epoch: Freeze yourself in stasis for 2.5s. Use it when an assassin dives you.

yurei.augment|Hallowed Reverberation: Your ranged Hallowed Strikes after each cast reach farther and bounce 2 more times. Great for spreading damage in teamfights and hitting from safer range.
yurei.Eternal|Pilow: You shrink a little, and each ability cast near enemy heroes stacks a debuff lowering their damage. Severance resets and Anima Burst keep it stacked while you fight.
yurei.minor|Bioluminescence: Enemies you damage take 3% more damage and are revealed for 4s, so targets cannot hide in brush or fog after you tag them with Whispering Echoes.
yurei.minor|Neurotoxin: Pilow stacks also make enemies take more damage. Since frequent casts keep Pilow up, your team hits harder.
yurei.crest|Ortus: Move speed and physical power for 7s, and takedowns while it runs give permanent power. Pop it before rushing in with Severance.
yurei.augment|Soul Weaver: Soulstorm grants damage reduction during its channel, more per hero hit, and comes back sooner. Helps you survive the 1.5s channel while standing in the enemy team.
yurei.Eternal|Vermis: Every third basic attack in a row on the same hero deals a chunk of their max health. Cast an ability, then your two fast Hallowed Strikes plus one more hit reach it quickly.
yurei.minor|Serration: Vermis also takes some of the target's missing health, making your third hit a finisher.
yurei.minor|Breach: Soulstorm's damage cuts enemy physical armor by 35% for 4s, so the reset Severance and your follow-up attacks hit much harder.
